title: Senior Threat Intelligence Consultant (m/w/d)
description:
It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks! This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents.

All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS!

Tasks

As a Senior Threat Intelligence Consultant (m/w/d) located in Germany, you will be a key contributor within NVISO’s Threat Intelligence (TI) team, working closely with colleagues across our DACH and international teams to deliver high-quality threat intelligence services to our clients and to support other teams across the organization. Your work will help organizations better understand their threat landscape, anticipate emerging threats, and respond effectively to real-world adversary activity.

You will contribute across a broad range of threat intelligence activities, including strategic and operational intelligence, sector-specific threat landscapes, and continuous monitoring of open, deep, and dark web sources. Your intelligence will support not only incident response engagements, but also other NVISO services such as Managed Detection & Response (MDR) and Red Team operations, enabling detection, response, and adversary simulation activities with relevant and timely intelligence.

You will also contribute to intelligence-led security assessments such as TIBER-EU and TLPT, collaborating with experienced team members to develop realistic threat scenarios and actionable intelligence.

Working in a highly collaborative environment, you will focus on delivering accurate, relevant, and well-communicated intelligence outputs, while actively sharing knowledge and contributing to the continuous improvement of our services and ways of working.

  • Contribute to the delivery of high-quality threat intelligence services across strategic, operational, and tactical use cases.
  • Produce threat intelligence deliverables such as threat landscapes, adversary and campaign analysis, and sector-specific intelligence reports.
  • Perform continuous monitoring of open, deep, and dark web sources to identify relevant threats, exposures, and emerging risks.
  • Provide actionable threat intelligence in support of incident response engagements, helping to contextualize attacks and inform response decisions.
  • Support other NVISO teams such as MDR and Red Team by delivering intelligence that informs detection engineering, threat hunting, and adversary emulation activities.
  • Contribute to intelligence-led security assessments (e.g. TIBER-EU, TLPT), supporting threat research, scenario development, and reporting.
  • Support capability-building engagements such as TI maturity assessments, operating model design, and intelligence process implementation.
  • Participate in client-facing meetings and briefings, clearly communicating intelligence findings and insights.
  • Collaborate closely with team members to ensure consistency, quality, and continuous improvement of threat intelligence deliverables and processes.

Requirements

  • You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states or the Austrian citizenship;
  • 2–5 years of professional experience, including 1–3 years in cyber threat intelligence or a closely related cybersecurity role.
  • Hands-on experience contributing to strategic, operational, or tactical threat intelligence use cases.
  • Exposure to intelligence-led assessments such as TIBER-EU, TLPT, or comparable frameworks is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of threat actors, attacker tradecraft, and intelligence frameworks (e.g. MITRE ATT&CK), as well as the intelligence lifecycle.
  • Experience with open-source, deep, and dark web research and monitoring techniques.
  • Ability to work independently on defined tasks and collaborate effectively within a team on larger engagements.
  • Strong analytical and writing skills, with the ability to produce clear, structured, and high-quality intelligence deliverables.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills to work collaboratively with clients and cross-functional internal teams.
  • Up-to-date knowledge of current cyber threats, attacker TTPs, and emerging trends.
  • Language: German and English at C1+ proficiency for client-facing work across DACH.

Your availability

  • Standard business hours with occasional flexibility required during active client engagements and incident response support.

Travel

  • Some limited travel within DE/AT/CH (~10%) for onsite engagements, workshops, and stakeholder meetings

Benefits

At NVISO, we care. We are committed to offering you a highly competitive remuneration package including financial and non-financial components:

  • Working and learning from the best people in the European cyber security industry. We have multiple SANS Instructors working at NVISO, our staff has presented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc) and all of our technical staff can acquire deep technical security certifications (GSE, GXPN, GREM, GCFA, OSCP, etc);

title: GTM Growth Manager
description:
Voice is becoming the primary interface for technology. For the first time in history, we can use natural language to control and interact with our devices, services, and applications, and we’re only at the beginning of the adoption of Voice and Physical AI across industries. Current voice interactions, however, still lack a fundamental human skill: nuanced understanding of audio scenes and environments. Navigating complex auditory scenes, distinguishing between multiple voices, or focusing on a main speaker are all part of the challenge of “teaching machines to hear like human beings.”

At ai-coustics, we’re building the audio intelligence layer and developer tooling to enable more robust and intelligent voice agents and Physical AI applications. Today, Voice AI companies like Perplexity, Retell, LiveKit or AssemblyAI use the ai-coustics SDK to prepare their agents for real-world acoustic challenges. Our models power thousands of agents worldwide and process millions of hours each month.

We are backed by leading early-stage investors including Connect Ventures, Partech, Inovia Capital, as well as angel investors from HuggingFace, DeepMind and Amazon with deep expertise in AI and developer infrastructure. These partners share our vision and are helping us build a world-class team operating with high levels of responsibility and velocity. We look for people who take ownership, think systemically, and want to solve challenging real-world problems in close collaboration with our customers. If you’re motivated by developing technology that is used in practice, shaping an emerging category and setting a new standard for how Voice AI works in the real world, you’ll feel at home at ai-coustics.

About the role

Developers find us, install the SDK, and start processing audio before we ever speak to them. Thousands of accounts have run audio through our models. Some become customers, but many sit somewhere between a first test and real production use. The opportunity is to identify the accounts with real potential, understand what moves them from testing to paying, and find what makes them grow from there.

You own that journey, from reaching promising developers and teams to converting and growing them. You use product and usage data to decide where to focus, get involved in promising evaluations early, and close startup and mid-market deals. You also experiment with outbound approaches to reach new prospects, identify ways to expand existing customers, and build and test the pricing and operational systems that make the whole motion work.

This isn't a conventional sales role or a RevOps role. It is a job for someone who wants to do both. If you only want to close, this will frustrate you. If you only want to analyse, you'll be uncomfortable when a number depends on you picking up the phone.

Tasks

  • Signup to paid — Carry the conversion number. Work out which trials are real, get into the evaluation early, cut time-to-value, and remove what's blocking the purchase.
  • Outbound — Own the motion end to end: target lists, sequencing, messaging, cadence, and the tooling. Run experiments and double down on what converts.
  • Full-cycle sales — Run startup and mid-market deals end to end: discovery, qualification, technical evaluation, pricing, negotiation, close.
  • Expansion and retention — Own NRR. Most start on one model and a fraction of their traffic. Find the next use case, catch the accounts going quiet before they churn, win back the ones that left.
  • Account intelligence — Build the scoring layer. Turn usage data into a ranked list, and keep the ICP current as the market moves.
  • Rev ops and reporting — Own HubSpot, the funnel model and the monthly numbers. You keep them accurate because we make decisions from them, and everyone from the board down reads the numbers you produce.
  • Pricing and packaging — Run experiments on the self-serve tiers: what's in each plan, where the limits sit, what triggers an upgrade. Ship, measure, roll out what lifts conversion.
  • AI-native operations — Build agents and automations across your whole role, pipeline generation to revenue operations. We already run this way and you'll extend it.
  • Voice of customer — Gather feedback from customer interactions so product knows what to build and marketing knows how to position.

Requirements

  • 2–5 years in a commercial role at a startup or scale-up, ideally with an AI, developer, API or infrastructure product, where you carried a number and personally owned part of a funnel. You've worked somewhere growing fast and know what it's like when the playbook doesn't exist yet, the targets move, and nobody hands you a territory.
  • You've closed. You can talk about specific deals you won and lost, and what you'd do differently.
  • Love data. You can build a funnel in a product analytics tool, interrogate a CRM, write a query to check a hunch, and spot when a number is lying to you. We use PostHog and HubSpot.
  • Experiment discipline. You can design a test, judge whether the result means anything, and say so when it doesn't.
  • Tool fluency. Claude Code, Codex, Lemlist, HubSpot, PostHog. You're fast on the stack and faster picking up what's next.
  • Comfortable with a technical buyer. You can follow a conversation about latency, benchmarks, SDK integration and model behaviour, ask useful questions, and know when to bring an engineer in.
  • You sell the way developers buy. Our customers evaluate before they talk to anyone and respond to evidence.
  • You use AI daily as an operational tool, not an experiment. You build workflows with it and have opinions about where it helps and where it produces noise.
  • Strong copywriting skills and written communication. You're able to A/B test copy and see what customers respond to.
  • High agency. You're joining a commercial team still being built, with no established playbook. Your instinct should be to go and find out rather than wait to be briefed.
  • Commercial generalist. You're comfortable wearing several hats in a day and don't wait for someone to define the lane.
  • Working language is English. German is useful and not required.
  • Bonus: you've worked in voice AI, speech or audio before. Not a requirement, but it will shorten your first month. Our customers are building voice agents and the vocabulary is specific. Caring about sound and how it works helps.

Benefits

  • Opportunity to work at a rapidly growing Voice AI startup, backed by top investors.
  • Compensation and equity: Competitive salary package, additional benefits and stock options, enabling you to take part in the company’s success.
  • Startup Culture: Dynamic, fast-paced environment with passionate and collaborative colleagues.
  • High Impact: Groundbreaking startup at a pivotal growth stage, making a real difference in how people experience audio.
  • Ownership & Autonomy: Take full ownership of projects and ship fast.
  • Work With the Best: World-class team of engineers and builders with ample room for professional growth.
  • Contribute to the Future: Define the landscape of Voice AI technology.

If you are ready to lead the charge in revolutionizing Voice AI and drive our startup to new heights, we would love to hear from you. Apply today to join the ai-coustics team!

title: (Senior) QA Engineer - AI-Driven Testing (m/f/d)
description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn about our Product & Tech team!

Deine Position

As part of our Mobile App Platform team, you will own the quality strategy of our Flutter apps, and change how we approach testing.

AI-driven QA is the differentiator in this role. Our QA team already uses AI for test generation, but we want to go much further. You will help reinvent it: autonomous exploration, smarter test orchestration, self-directed QA workflows, and QA systems that detect product risks before they reach users.

This is not a "write test cases and file tickets" role. You co-create systems and practices that enable our product teams to own product quality end-to-end and work with them to close the gaps so we can ship with confidence. Speed boost instead of speed bump.
You think about quality as something you design into the product and process, not a checklist you run before release, effectively shifting quality assurance left.

Our Stack

  • Flutter & Dart
  • Appium, BrowserStack
  • Testmo for test case management
  • GCP, GitHub Actions, Datadog, LaunchDarkly
  • AI-assisted development with Cursor and agentic coding workflows
  • Linear, Notion, Figma, Miro Key Responsibilities
  • App Platform Quality Ownership: Own the quality strategy of our Flutter apps and testing architecture across our mobile product teams from a platform standpoint, including test strategy, execution, and production monitoring
  • Platform Collaboration & Support: Partner closely with cross-functional mobile product teams to shape quality practices, close testing gaps, and enable teams to ship with confidence
  • Automated Test Suite Management: Grow and maintain our automated test suite (Appium / BrowserStack), keeping it fast, stable, trusted, and focused on critical user journeys
  • Test Infrastructure Health: Keep test infrastructure healthy with minimized flakiness, faster runs, and actionable results for the entire engineering organization
  • Autonomous & AI-Driven Exploration: Create and scale autonomous exploration, intelligent test orchestration, and self-directed testing workflows from scratch to detect product risks before they reach users

Dein Profil

  • User-Centric Quality Focus: Strong focus on real-world user journeys, edge cases, and product risk rather than relying solely on code coverage metrics
  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: High initiative and problem-solving drive to invent solutions from scratch when no standard playbook exists
  • QA Architecture & Mobile Automation: Extensive experience designing scalable testing strategies and hands-on expertise with mobile automation frameworks (Appium, Flutter integration testing) and cloud device farms (BrowserStack)
  • Practical AI & Agentic Workflows: Active experience leveraging AI tools, LLM workflows, and testing agents for autonomous exploration, automated test generation, and defect analysis
  • CI/CD & Platform Enablement: Proven track record of integrating test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) to deliver fast quality signals and co-creating practices that enable product teams to own quality without sacrificing velocity
  • User-Centric Quality & Communication: Focus on real-world user journeys and risk mitigation over simple coverage metrics, backed by strong English communication skills to guide engineering practices Bonus points for:
  • German language skills
  • Experience with energy systems, IoT, or climate tech
  • Native iOS/Android or deep Flutter/Dart architecture knowledge
  • Track record of navigating ambiguity
  • Experience in building testing tools from scratch

Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
  • You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups
  • You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
  • Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
  • Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens
  • Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

Deine Mission:

  • Ad-hoc-Engagement-Kampagnen: Du planst, verfasst und setzt Newsletter-Initiativen um, die gezielt die Nutzerinteraktion in unserer B2C-App-Community in Deutschland, Österreich, den Niederlanden und Großbritannien steigern.

Daraus leitest du konkrete Maßnahmen ab, um Engagement und User Retention nachhaltig zu steigern.

  • Team-Unterstützung: Du unterstützt das gesamte CRM-Team im Tagesgeschäft, hilfst beim Aufbau automatisierter Workflows und schaffst so Möglichkeiten für Strategie und Prozessoptimierung.

The role

 

Help merchants get more from their partnership with Wolt and Deliveroo.

 

Reporting to the EMEA B2B Content Team Lead, you will own merchant content programmes across both brands, with a particular focus on helping existing merchants improve their operations, discover opportunities and grow their businesses.

 

You will identify the merchant problems worth addressing, develop the content strategy and lead delivery with colleagues across Marketing, Commercial, Operations and Product. You will also write and edit the content yourself, combining strong editorial judgement with clear ownership of performance.

 

Your core portfolio will include merchant editorial content, customer stories, thought leadership and campaigns that support merchant success. This is a senior individual contributor role with responsibility for setting priorities, leading programmes and demonstrating their impact.

 

What you will own

 

  • Merchant editorial programmes. Build and manage a focused content plan across both brands, including the merchant blog, practical business guidance and thought leadership. Use merchant research, frontline feedback and performance data to decide what deserves investment.

  • Merchant stories and proof. Develop a repeatable case-study programme, from identifying merchants and conducting interviews to securing evidence, approvals and reusable assets.

  • Merchant campaigns. Lead the content strategy and delivery for agreed merchant initiatives, including operational improvements and relevant seasonal occasions. Establish the audience, desired action, content approach, responsibilities and measures before production begins.

  • Content creation and quality. Write and edit compelling content across articles, reports, case studies, email and campaign assets. Brief designers, freelancers and other contributors where needed.

  • Delivery across brands and markets. Coordinate stakeholders, approvals and localisation, adapting content to the needs of each brand and market.

  • Performance and improvement. Set baselines and targets with the relevant teams, monitor results and use them to improve, expand or stop content activity.

 

How you will work

 

You will partner with Growth on website and acquisition content, with GTM on priority launches and with CRM on merchant communications. Those teams own their respective strategies and channel execution; you will own the agreed content programme and its contribution.

 

Within Content, you will collaborate with the owners of merchant education, Ads & Promos, Commerce Platform and social. The Team Lead will continue to lead priority event content during the transition; you may develop stories or campaigns from those events where they support your portfolio.

 

What success looks like

 

You will be accountable for three areas, with targets agreed once baselines and tracking are established:

 

  • Merchant action: the proportion of merchants who take the intended next step after engaging with your content, where tracking allows.

  • Useful engagement: meaningful consumption of priority content, measured through relevant indicators such as engaged reading, completion or repeat engagement.

  • Use of merchant proof: adoption and reuse of case studies and evidence by Commercial and Marketing, with feedback on their effectiveness.

 

You will report what is working, what is not and what you recommend changing. Wider retention and growth outcomes will be shared with the teams responsible for them.

  • A track record of independently building and improving B2B content programmes, with examples of measurable results.

  • Excellent writing, editing and interviewing skills, supported by a portfolio of substantive work such as case studies, editorial programmes, reports or campaigns.

  • Experience leading campaigns across functions, including setting priorities, resolving competing requests and coordinating delivery.

  • Confidence using analytics and research to make decisions, define success and explain the limits of attribution.

  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to turn complex product or operational information into useful merchant content.

  • Experience adapting content across markets, working with specialists and managing external contributors.

  • Experience in marketplaces, merchant services, hospitality, retail or B2B technology would be valuable.

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

description:
Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

Working on the Site Reliability Team, you'll help build and maintain world-class infrastructure to meet the needs of millions of users protecting their privacy online. You'll utilize high-level languages like Perl, Go, TypeScript, or Python and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

  • Ensuring our Duck.ai product meets our reliability standards and minimizing user friction on failures

  • Scaling up our own index infrastructure to handle billions of documents

  • Create anti fraud verifications that respect users privacy

 

As Director, Site Reliability Engineering, you'll dive deep into complex operational challenges, including software, systems, automation, and process analysis. We are looking for candidates who can read, write, troubleshoot, and deploy all types of software to help us tackle the reliability challenges of large-scale deployments.

 

About You

  • 10+ years relevant professional experience in reliability, platform, infrastructure, or software engineering, including 4+ years leading SRE teams.

  • Experience participating in a 24x7 on-call rotation for a large-scale deployment.

  • Ability to lead and collaborate on high-impact and complex projects from proposal through postmortem.

  • Proficient in AI-driven development, including designing and implementing agentic workflows

  • Skills to wrangle vague problems, propose innovative solutions, and execute them with a strong focus on metrics.

  • Experience developing effective tools, services, alerts, and responses to identify and address reliability risks.

  • Foresight to help identify the future technical direction of our deployment with the goal of improving reliability and performance.

  • Advanced programming skills enabling close partnership with software engineers to triage production issues and identify appropriate remediation, including code changes and performance considerations.

Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Senior Product Designer

Didomi is looking for a Senior Product Designer to take end-to-end ownership of design across multiple products within our Privacy and Consent Management Platform. This is a senior IC role reporting directly to the Design Director, acting as design peer-lead within the Product team, supporting seven Product Managers and their engineering teams. Design is currently the one shared resource across the entire product org, and this role is central to how we scale it.

You'll help shape the future of our product, creating experiences that are intuitive, efficient, and user-centric, while collaborating closely with cross-functional partners. You'll get involved early, shaping problems alongside Product and Engineering rather than just executing against requirements handed to you, and take ownership of your workstreams once scope is assigned based on where the business needs it most.

What you'll do

  • Own the process end-to-end. Lead discovery through delivery for your assigned product areas, handing off finalized UX/functional design to our external creative agency for UI polish.
  • Shape decisions upstream. Get involved before requirements are locked, and bring evidence and clear rationale to engineering-first decisions rather than reacting after the fact.
  • Take ownership across ambiguity. Hold multiple complex workstreams and adapt as scope shifts with business priorities.
  • Build the research muscle. Help establish research and usability practices that don't fully exist today, and translate findings into decisions Product and Engineering can act on.
  • Reduce design debt. Flag and help prevent downstream friction from features shipping without a design pass.
  • Prototype fast with AI. Use tools like Figma Make or Claude to turn concepts into high-level, testable prototypes quickly, helping the team validate direction and unblock decisions without waiting on full design cycles for every idea.
  • Foster a strong design culture. Share knowledge, mentor peers, and help improve team processes.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years in product/UX design, with real ownership of complex products and a strong portfolio of shipped work.
  • Fluency in Figma or equivalent design/prototyping tools.
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-moving, engineering-heavy environments with limited day-to-day oversight.
  • Strong interaction and systems thinking. You can untangle complex flows and design for edge cases.
  • Experience building or contributing to a research practice where formal resourcing is limited.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work efficiently with cross-functional teams.
  • Proven experience designing zero-to-one products, new platforms, or defining new product spaces.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (Figma Make, Claude, or similar) to generate high-level prototypes and accelerate concept validation.

Strongly preferred: experience in privacy, compliance, or another highly regulated/technical domain.

title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux - CDD de 18 mois
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux pour rejoindre le département COMELEC à Télécom Paris.

Les fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal Fibers, HCPCF) ont récemment franchi une étape technologique majeure, avec des pertes de propagation pouvant atteindre 0.1 dB/km à 1550 nm, comparables, voire inférieures, à celles des fibres télécoms standards [1–2]. La lumière se propageant principalement dans l’air, les HCPCF présentent une latence réduite de 30 à 40 %, une dispersion ultra-faible et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables. Ces propriétés uniques en font des technologies particulièrement prometteuses pour les systèmes de télécommunications de nouvelle génération, la distribution quantique de clés (Quantum Key Distribution, QKD) sur longue distance et les applications de détection distribuée.

Le projet proposé vise à développer et démontrer la prochaine génération de fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (HCPCF) pour la transmission de données à haut débit et les applications de détection. La propagation de la lumière dans l’air plutôt que dans le verre permet aux HCPCF d’offrir une latence réduite et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables par rapport aux fibres de silice, répondant ainsi à certains des enjeux majeurs des futurs centres de données et réseaux optiques. Notre ambition est de démontrer une transmission à 400 Gbit/s sur quelques kilomètres à travers des échantillons de fibres issus de nouvelles architectures, et d’étudier le potentiel de ces HCPCF pour des applications de détection. La réalisation de ces objectifs nécessite de répondre à des spécifications exigeantes en matière de guidage monomode, de contrôle de la polarisation, ainsi que de faibles pertes par courbure et par couplage.

Deux équipes complémentaires assureront conjointement l'encadrement de ces travaux : le GPPMM, reconnu internationalement pour ses activités de conception et de fabrication de HCPCF [3–5], et le GTO, leader dans la démonstration de systèmes de communication optique et de détection à haut débit [6–8]. Un processus itératif entre la fabrication des fibres et leur caractérisation au niveau système permettra de s'assurer que leurs propriétés répondent aux exigences opérationnelles en matière de transmission et de détection. Sur le plan méthodologique, le projet combinera modélisation numérique, caractérisation et validation expérimentale dans la bande C. Les méthodes de modélisation et de traitement du signal développées au GTO pour le suivi de la polarisation contribueront à évaluer et à optimiser les performances de transmission des HCPCF conçues et caractérisées au GPPMM.

À propos du projet PLEIADES

Le projet PLEIADES s'inscrit dans le cadre du programme PEPR « Réseaux du futur », financé par l'ANR, et réunit un consortium de 14 partenaires. L'un des axes de travail porte sur les fibres à cœur creux de nouvelle génération et rassemble plusieurs laboratoires académiques, notamment LTCI, XLIM et PHLAM.

Vos principales missions seront de :

  • Assurer des missions de recherche dans le domaine de la photonique

  • Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat

  • Participer à la notoriété de l’Ecole, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris


Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat ou équivalent en génie électrique, communications, photonique, traitement du signal ou dans un domaine connexe. Vous disposez de solides connaissances en systèmes et réseaux de transmission optique ainsi qu’en traitement numérique du signal (DSP) appliqué aux systèmes de communication ou aux capteurs à fibre optique. La maîtrise de MATLAB et/ou Python pour le développement d’algorithmes DSP sera appréciée. Vous manifestez un intérêt marqué pour la recherche appliquée et êtes à l’aise dans un environnement multiculturel, notamment pour encadrer des stagiaires et/ou des étudiants. Une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais est indispensable. Vous disposez également de bonnes qualités relationnelles et pédagogiques, d’un bon esprit d’équipe et d’une capacité à synthétiser et à communiquer des informations complexes.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers).

title: Onboard Software Engineer - Peripheral Services
description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft’s Onboard Software group provides the on-orbit software that powers our satellite fleet — from the Linux services running on the Hub’s onboard computers, to the containerized workloads executing customer applications in low Earth orbit.

The Peripheral Services team owns the software that integrates third-party devices and payloads into Loft’s standardized satellite platform. We enable the control and monitoring of many key spacecraft components, including optical payloads, radios, power controllers, and GNSS receivers. Many of these components are reused across all satellite programs and form the building blocks of our onboard architecture.

The applications developed by our team handle the low-level communication protocol details, exposing the connected devices behind standardized APIs used across mission operations. The team is also responsible for the automation and orchestration that allows Loft to safely and reliably operate the equipment at scale.

In this role, you’ll help develop the software that connects diverse spacecraft hardware to the rest of the platform, and ultimately enables successful missions in orbit.


About this role:
  • Design, implement, and refine software with a high degree of ownership, driving impactful features from concept through delivery while ensuring robustness and reliability.
  • Review code, provide clear feedback, and enforce adherence to established development processes, style guides, and design standards to maintain consistency and quality across the codebase.
  • Design and implement unit and integration tests for both self-authored and peer-authored code.
  • Utilize version control systems to create feature branches, push code, and merge approved code into production branches.
  • Contribute to the onboard software architecture through design proposals and collaborative review
  • Participate in the review and enhancement of software development processes and design standards.
  • Coordinate with downstream teams on the distribution and adoption of the latest releases.
  • In addition to responsibilities within onboard software, you’ll have the opportunity to directly be involved in operating our on-orbit fleet of satellites.

Must Haves:
  • 3+ years' software engineering experience, using programming languages including C/C++ (C++11 or newer) and Python.
  • Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows
  • Experience with continuous integration tools (GitLab-CI, Jenkins, or similar).
  • Knowledge of build systems (e.g., Make, CMake).
  • Understanding of distributed architecture.
  • Familiarity with networking protocols (e.g., UDP, TCP, IP) and POSIX standards.
  • Experience in developing multi-threaded applications.
  • Previous team leader or manager role

Nice to Haves:
  • Familiarity with additional programming languages, such as Go or Rust.
  • Experience with embedded Linux operation, including Yocto, device trees, systemd, and Linux on ARM platforms.
  • Proficiency with unit test frameworks (e.g., pytest, Googletest, Unity)
  • Experience with middleware framework (gRPC, ZMQ/NATS, etc.)
  • Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, K3S, systemd-nspawn)
  • Experience with space systems and concepts

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
  • Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable

    Who We Are

    Loft: Space Made Simple. 

    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.

    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
description:
What Quadrants is

Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research.

The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton.

It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public.

The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast.

The role

You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap.

Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further.

It calls for two things at once: the low-level GPU and compiler skill to make a single kernel optimal, and the ability to keep the whole system coherent as it grows.

The core tradeoff is settled: usability comes first. When usability and performance collide, usability wins, unless the cost is severe. We will limit what the system supports to go fast (static shapes and fixed-size allocation baked into kernels, say), but never the convenience of the API itself. Experts who want maximum performance and full control over the generated code get lower-level escape hatches, down to inline assembly, C, or PTX.

Your mandate is to build the best open-source Python compiler for physics simulation out there. No limit on what that takes. If it means replacing the entire engine, your call. Either way, you keep Quadrants healthy and unblocking the company in the meantime.

What you’ll own

  • API & authoring experience. The surface that physics and numerical-computing engineers write against, and, as an open-source library, the product’s face to the world. Idiomatic, natural to Python users, never a separate language bolted onto Python. Clean decorators, legible constraints, sharp errors, real escape hatches.

  • IR, lowering & backends. A stable IR that lowers to multiple backends, with room to grow and the door kept open for differentiable simulation. Today the computation graph is expressed through Quadrants’ own constructs. Recovering it automatically from ordinary Python is hard, and a long-term goal rather than today’s reality.

  • Optimization. Turn naive code into strong execution plans: vectorization, register and shared-memory usage, barriers and atomics, cooperative threading, dead-buffer and redundant-traffic elimination, dropping needless synchronization. Move low-level optimization off users and into the platform.

  • Primitives. Cholesky, eigendecomposition, matmul, reductions, solver kernels. Each owned with its correctness, benchmarks, and regression tracking.

  • Watching Genesis and the compiler together. Hunt for performance wins on both sides, in Genesis and in Quadrants itself. Propose API changes that cut duplication, improve readability, and reduce platform-specific special-casing. Less to maintain, more that simply works.

  • The project as a product. Benchmark real workloads, track performance over time, catch regressions early. Stay close to users (Genesis first), find friction and missing abstractions, drive adoption, set direction.

Who you are

You reason about whole systems and have taste for where complexity should live. You measure before you optimize, and you reach for memory traffic and launch overhead before FLOPs. You have opinions about API design. You write tests and benchmarks as you go, not afterward.

The ground that judgment stands on:

  • GPU. What optimal looks like and why: access patterns, registers, shared memory, barriers, atomics, threading. CPU intuition a plus.

  • Python & API taste. Idiomatic Python. A feel for what’s natural to Python users. APIs that free users rather than constrain them.

  • Compilers. The path from authoring to kernels (IR, lowering, optimization), weighed against maintainability.

And how you work: proactive and largely self-directed. You fetch context across the company instead of waiting for it. You’re comfortable talking to the engineers who use what you build, and at ease designing in the open for users you’ll never meet. Ready to grow into leading a small team (a couple of people, near term).

What great looks like

People adopt Quadrants from outside Genesis. Engineers write clearer code with less boilerplate. Kernels keep getting faster. Performance is tracked, not guessed. The architecture gets easier to extend, not harder.

What we’re uncompromising about

How you work is up to you. What matters is that your ownership grows over time: blind spots shrink, the parts you can vouch for expand, technical debt goes down, the core stays sound.

That takes treating understanding as real work, not overhead. You read and challenge the codebase instead of just stacking features on it. You take nothing you did not write for granted. You watch the competition and what’s coming next, and you bring it in and ship it.

Use AI agents if they help. They are productivity tools, not code owners. You are.

Accounts Receivable Accountant

Permanent employee · Full-time · Berlin (HQ)

Our Mission For You

Own the process that turns invoices into cash, and shape how trawa's Finance function scales with our customer base.

trawa enables mid-sized industrial and commercial companies to access green, intelligent energy. We're in a hyper-growth phase in one of the most complex markets in Germany. It's a rare moment to join: the foundations are being built right now, the problems are real, and the room to shape how Finance runs at scale is wide open.

This is one of the most critical roles in the company. Cash is what enables trawa's growth, and you own the process that protects it. Every reconciliation you close, every overdue account you resolve, every dispute you clean up feeds directly into how fast we can move.

As our Accounts Receivable Accountant, you'll own the end-to-end AR and collections process. You'll be the person customers talk to when something on an invoice isn't clear, and the person internally who makes sure open items don't stay open. You'll work closely with Customer Success, Business Operations, and our Finance team.

If you're excited by ownership, an AI-first way of working, and building something that actually matters, this is your role.


What You'll Own

Collections and Dunning

  • Own the collections cadence end-to-end: monitor AR aging, prioritise the highest-impact accounts, and drive them to resolution via email and phone.

  • Reduce DSO measurably. You set the pace, we give you the tools and the mandate.

  • Manage our dunning process reliably and with the right tone: firm on cash, respectful of the customer relationshipDebitorenbuchhaltung und operative Prozesse.

Reconciliation and Cash Application

  • Reconcile incoming payments against open invoices, investigate and resolve unapplied cash, short-pays, and discrepancies.

  • Run structured reconciliations reliably, and independently drive ad-hoc analyses for complex payments or edge cases.

  • Support month-end close with AR reconciliations and clean aging reports.

Ticket Ownership and Customer Interaction

  • Take ownership of our AR ticket queue, which is currently high-volume and one of the most visible pain points across the company. You get on top of it, categorise what's coming in, and resolve the majority of tickets directly.

  • Be the go-to Finance contact for customers on all relevant topics: invoicing, payments, and account requests.

  • Work closely with Customer Success and BizOps to resolve customer issues end-to-end and make sure Finance topics don't get stuck between teams.


Who You Are

Must-haves

  • 3+ years of experience in Accounts Receivable, Collections, or Credit Control, or a comparable Finance role. Ideally in a high-volume and complex B2B environment

  • Solid understanding of AR processes: dunning, cash application, reconciliations, and month-end AR work.

  • Confident with customers in writing and on the phone. You can be firm on cash without damaging the relationship.

  • Strong ownership mindset. You don't wait for someone to flag a problem. You spot it, dig into the root cause, and drive it to resolution across stakeholders.

  • Structured, analytical, and detail-oriented. You keep complex open items straight without losing the bigger picture.

  • Business fluent in English and solid written German (customer correspondence in German needs to work reliably). Spoken German is a strong plus but not required.

  • Comfortable in the standard office and analytics toolset (Excel or Google Sheets) and able to navigate independently.

Nice-to-haves

  • A degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a comparable field, or a solid vocational qualification (e.g. Bilanzbuchhalter:in IHK, Steuerfachangestellte:r, kaufmännische Ausbildung). We care about what you can do, not the badge on your CV.

  • Experience with AI-powered reconciliation tools or modern ticketing systems.

  • Genuine curiosity for AI and automation. Bonus if you've already used Langdock, Claude, or similar tools to speed up your own work.

  • Experience in a fast-growing start-up or scale-up environment.


Your First 90 Days

Month 1: Understand

description:
Runa is pioneering a first-of-its-kind payment rail that enables the seamless, global money movement at scale. Legacy banking and payment infrastructure struggles to support the demands of today's low-volume, high-velocity payouts, leading to inefficiencies in global payouts. Runa transforms this landscape by providing a new digital payments infrastructure that empowers businesses to send digital money instantly and cost-free to anyone, anywhere. title: Chief Financial Officer (all genders)
description:
Your mission

deskbird is one of Europe's fastest-growing workplace-management platforms – a SaaS success story serving hundreds of enterprise customers and building the operating system for the workplace of the future, well past €10M ARR and scaling with an efficiency-driven playbook. In 2025 we closed a funding round led by Octopus Ventures, with co-investments from NEVA SGR (Intesa Sanpaolo Bank) and AVP, and participation from Alstin Capital, session, and Portfolion.


We're hiring a Chief Financial Officer (all genders) to be a true co-pilot to the management team. This is not just a back-office finance role. You will sit in board meetings from day one, own the equity story, lead our future financing rounds and capital markets strategy, and run an AI-first operations function that becomes a case study in how lean a modern finance organization can be.


You'll join a small, talented, highly ambitious executive team – and the equity package is designed so that when we win, you win meaningfully.


If you are passionate about creating enterprise value, scaling finance organizations, and owning the story you used to analyze – this is that seat.



In this role you will

  1. The equity story and funding readiness. You will keep deskbird in the best possible shape for whatever comes next - future financing rounds, strategic options, and long-term value creation. Narrative, metrics, data room, diligence readiness: always current, always credible. When we choose to run a process, you will lead it, working directly with the founders and board.

  2. The path to profitability. You’ll own the plan that takes us to sustainable positive cash flows profitability without sacrificing growth: driver-based planning, disciplined capital allocation, and a sharp view on where every franc and euro works hardest.

  3. An AI-first finance & operations function. We want a hands-on operator on the edge of AI development who automates before hiring, works in the models and tools personally, and proves that a lean, AI-augmented team can outperform a traditional org several times its size. We don’t want a CFO who builds a 20-person department.

  4. Commercial intelligence for GTM and Product. You’ll drive the insights that tell us where to invest: which segments, motions, and product bets deliver the strongest combined growth and efficiency profile. Finance at deskbird is a value driver in pricing, packaging, NRR economics, and unit-economics decisions - not just a scorekeeper.

  5. International structure and tax efficiency. You’ll own our multi-entity group structure across Europe, introduce transfer pricing, and ensure we operate in a tax-efficient, fully compliant setup as we scale internationally.

  6. The cap table and investor-grade financials. You’ll keep our cap table and VSOP clean, well-modeled, and always ready for the next financing round, and bring our accounting to the  standard any institutional investor expects - SaaS revenue recognition (local GAAP) done right, smooth statutory audits, and, where a future process demands it, conversion to the relevant GAAP.

  7. Board and investor relations. You’ll run the reporting rhythm, build trust with our existing investors, and represent deskbird credibly to future ones - from day one, alongside the founders.

  8. Cash, risk, and the operational backbone. Treasury, FX, and runway discipline, scenario planning, audit readiness, and oversight of legal, procurement, and insurance.



What you need to be successful

Must-haves

  • A transaction-shaped career: ideally PE, M&A or investment banking, followed by operating experience in a scaling company - you’ve seen deals from the inside and know what investors actually sign up for. (Exceptional candidates from transaction advisory (e.g. Big4) or top-tier strategy consulting with strong deal exposure will also be considered.)
  • Deep fluency in finance processes and B2B SaaS mechanics: ARR/NRR, cohort economics, CAC payback, Rule of 40, the ARR-to-cash bridge.
  • Experience at our scale and complexity (>€10M ARR, ~100+ employees) - and ideally, you’ve already seen what comes next (>€25M ARR), so you know what to build now and what to deliberately skip.
  • Fundraising and/or liquidity event exposure, ideally where the story was efficient, profitable growth rather than growth at all costs.
  • A builder’s ego profile: you measure yourself by enterprise value created per person on your team, not by headcount or budget owned. You’re hands-on and want to stay that way.
  • Genuine excitement about AI-native ways of working - you’re already using these tools daily and want to push further.
  • Based in or willing to work from one of our hubs - Zurich, Berlin, Munich, or London (remote within Europe is possible for an outstanding candidate, but hub-based is our strong preference given the closeness to founders and board). Full working proficiency in English; German is strongly preferred.
Nice to have
  • Experience owning or partnering closely with People & Culture.
  • Multi-entity European operations: Swiss/EU accounting, VAT, transfer pricing, cross-border payroll.
  • Venture debt, structured financing, or buy-side M&A experience.


What’s in it for you?


  • A rare stage - big enough to matter (>€10M ARR, enterprise customers, proven playbook), small enough that your fingerprints will be on everything.
  • Meaningful equity upside - a package built for a founder-like profile in a capital-efficient business, where the value you help create is value you share in.
  • A real seat at the table - board meetings from day one, direct partnership with the founders, and full ownership of your domain.
  • An AI-first culture - the freedom (and expectation) to build the most modern finance function in European SaaS.
  • A high-talent, low-ego executive team that moves fast and debates openly.

title: Territory Sales Partner
description:
Build Your Own Sales Business with Omada.ai

Omada.ai is the AI-powered marketing platform built for small businesses. We handle social media, email marketing, ads, and reputation management — so local business owners can stop being reluctant marketers and get back to doing what they love.

We’re venture-backed by HubSpot Ventures and Crosslink Capital, growing fast, and looking for independent, ambitious sales partners across the UK who want to earn serious money introducing local businesses to Omada.

The Opportunity

This isn’t a job — it’s a partnership. As an Omada Territory Sales Partner, you run your own independent sales operation. You choose your hours, your territory, your approach. We provide the product, the resources, and a compensation structure that means you’re never working for free.

  • Guaranteed Weekly Draw: £500/week guaranteed minimum — as long as you’re hitting your trial targets. This isn’t commission-only.

  • Commission: £250–£350 per closed account (tier-dependent) with uncapped earnings. Top partners earn £4,000–£8,000+ per month.

  • Structure: Self-employed (sole trader or limited company). You invoice us. You manage your own tax.

  • Location: Your local city. Must be based in the United Kingdom.

  • Schedule: Entirely your own. Work when it suits you — mornings, evenings, weekends. Your business, your call.

How the Draw Works

We believe in setting our partners up for success. That’s why every Territory Partner receives a guaranteed weekly draw of £500 — as long as you’re generating results.

  • Weeks 1–4: Generate at least 3 free trial signups per week → receive £500 guaranteed that week

  • Week 5 onward: Generate at least 4 free trial signups per week → receive £500 guaranteed that week

  • In any week where your commissions from closed accounts exceed £500, you earn the full commission instead

  • The draw is ongoing — not just for your first month. Hit your numbers, get paid. Every week.

This means you’re never working for nothing while your pipeline builds. Trials convert to paying customers, commissions grow, and the draw becomes your floor — not your ceiling.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be visiting local businesses — salons, restaurants, gyms, coffee shops, pet groomers, dental practices — and showing them how Omada.ai can handle their marketing while they focus on running their business.

A typical approach might look like this:

  • Identify businesses in your area that could benefit from better marketing

  • Walk in and start a conversation — "Hi, I work with Omada.ai. Who handles your social media?"

  • Show a quick demo on your phone

  • Offer a 14-day free trial — no risk for them

  • Follow up — when they convert, you earn your commission

We provide a resource kit with demo scripts, objection-handling guides, and territory mapping tools. How you use them is entirely up to you.

Who Thrives as a Territory Partner

  • Self-starters who don’t need someone managing their diary

  • People comfortable walking into a business and starting a conversation

  • Entrepreneurial types who want to build something, not just clock hours

  • Anyone with sales, field marketing, or B2B experience (helpful but not required)

  • People who want uncapped income tied to their effort, not a salary cap

What You’ll Need

  • UK-based with the right to work in the United Kingdom

  • Registered (or willing to register) as self-employed with HMRC

  • Smartphone with internet access

  • Reliable transport or a walkable territory with high business density

  • The drive to build your own business

No degree required. No prior sales experience required. If you can hold a conversation and you’re willing to put in the work, we’ll provide the resources to help you succeed.

The Career Path

Omada Sales Territory Partners aren’t capped. Top performers progress through a clear leadership pathway with increasing commission rates, territory ownership, and team-building opportunities:

  • Territory Partner — You’re in the field, closing deals, building your reputation.

  • City Captain — Exclusive city territory, higher commissions, and the opportunity to mentor new partners.

  • State Director — Leading a regional team with override commissions on your team’s closes.

  • Regional Director — Multi-region leadership with premium compensation.

  • Country Manager — Running Omada’s field operation for an entire market.

About Omada.ai

We’re an AI-powered marketing platform built specifically for small businesses. We handle social media, email marketing, ads, and reputation management — so business owners can stop worrying about marketing and focus on what they do best.

We’re backed by HubSpot Ventures and Crosslink Capital, growing across the UK, and building a network of Territory Partners who want to win.

Ready to start? Apply now

Self-employed contractor opportunity. Equal opportunity partner programme.

title: Founding Head of GTM - Cipherscale
description:
The Opportunity: Zero-to-one category creation for AI-Native Zero Trust Access

Cipherscale is building an AI-native Zero Trust access and enforcement plane for humans, software/workloads, and AI agents.

The product doctrine is simple: AI may reason and propose; deterministic policy authorizes; trusted enforcement executes.

We are looking for a commercial founder/operator who can turn that architecture into a category, a repeatable customer problem, real deployments, and initial revenue.

Mission: discover and prove the repeatable commercial truth for Cipherscale - who urgently needs it, what gets them to deploy, what makes them pay, and what causes them to expand.

What You Own

• Own ICP discovery, exclusion criteria, buyer/champion mapping, problem validation, positioning, initial wedge, and design-partner recruitment.

• Personally lead early customer discovery, technical/commercial conversations, executive outreach, design-partner conversion, and initial closing.

• Build an evidence-driven GTM system: every important assumption has supporting/contradicting evidence and a next falsification test.

• Use AI agents aggressively for research, account intelligence, personalization, competitive monitoring, meeting preparation, call synthesis, content, and experiment analysis.

• Work directly with the CEO on category creation and major strategic accounts.

• Work with Product and Engineering to convert recurring customer evidence into governed product inputs - without turning prospect anecdotes into roadmap commitments.

• Define the first repeatable acquisition, deployment, conversion, and expansion motion before scaling a team.

What This Role Is Not

• It is not a traditional marketing leadership job.

• It is not an MQL, impressions, content-calendar, or brand-campaign role.

• It is not a decision to hire SDR, demand-gen, content, and marketing-ops teams before product-market evidence exists.

• It is not ownership of OpenVPN growth. Rod, Head of Growth, owns the established-business growth mandate;

This role is focused on Cipherscale zero-to-one GTM and must collaborate cleanly without duplicating authority.

Important:

  • This is a full-time remote job, and it will be a long-term B2B contract.

  • This can be a permanent employment opportunity for candidates based in Spain, Poland, and Germany.

Our philosophy is that we are a small, close-knit team, and we care deeply about you:

  • Highly competitive salary + Bonus

  • Fully remote work environments.

  • Self-managed time off.


Who We Want

• You have personally helped take a deeply technical B2B security, infrastructure, identity, developer, cloud, or AI

product from near-zero to repeatable initial revenue.

• You can sit with a CISO, CTO, security architect, platform engineer, and AI-platform leader and earn credibility.

• You understand enough security architecture to reason about identity, delegated authority, credentials, policy,

enforcement, trust boundaries, auditability, and blast radius.

• You are comfortable selling before there is a polished playbook and learning directly from rejection.

• You treat AI as operating leverage. Your instinct is to build agentic workflows before asking for headcount.

• You are analytical enough to distinguish activity from evidence and evidence from causality.

• You are comfortable challenging the CEO and product assumptions when customer evidence disagrees.

Strong Background Signals

• Early-stage Zero Trust, identity, cloud security, developer security, infrastructure security, AI security, developer infrastructure, or adjacent enterprise-security categories.

• Founder, first-GTM, product-led commercial operator, technical seller, or hands-on GTM executive backgrounds can all fit.

• Large-company titles alone are not compelling.

Anti-Profile

• Your first answer to a growth problem is "hire a team."

• You depend on agencies for core positioning or customer discovery.

• You optimize lead volume before proving deployment and retention.

• You cannot personally run technical discovery or executive selling.

• You treat AI as a copywriting assistant rather than an operating system.

• You blur probabilistic AI recommendations with authorization or security enforcement.

First 90 Days: Window Expected outcome

• 0-30 days: 10-15 qualified ICP conversations; ~5 credible design-partner candidates; evidence-backed recommendation on ICP, problem, buyer, positioning, and wedge.

• 31-60 days: Convert the strongest partners into real or production-like deployments; measure time-to-value, blockers, security objections, and willingness to pay.

• 61-90 days: Target 5+ production or production-intent deployments where product readiness permits; first paying customers; prove or disprove repeatability with a second cohort; document the acquisition/onboarding motion.

How Success Is Measured

• Business: paid customers, initial ARR/MRR, expansion and eventually defensible unit economics.

• Customer: time-to-first-value, production activation, repeated authorized usage, protected resources/principals,

retention and expansion.

• Funnel: qualified conversations -> design partners -> deployments -> production -> paid -> expansion.

• Learning velocity: experiment cycle time, evidence quality, speed at which weak assumptions are killed or corrected.

Operating Model and Reporting

title: Senior Product Manager - Dictation
description:
About Nabla

We are a team of entrepreneurs, clinicians and engineers committed to bringing back joy to the practice of medicine.

Together with a community of clinician innovators, we’ve harnessed the best of machine learning science to develop Nabla: the leading AI assistant that’s restoring the human connection at the heart of healthcare. By streamlining clinical documentation, Nabla is helping clinicians focus on what matters most - patient care. Today, over 100,000+ clinicians across 130+ healthcare organizations trust Nabla to support how they deliver care every day.

We’re at the start of an ambitious journey: Ambient listening, dictation, coding, and command capabilities are all converging into a proactive assistant that intuitively streamlines clinical and financial workflows.

Backed by a recent $70M Series C, we’re hiring to build the next generation of clinical AI and improve the lives of clinicians and patients everywhere.

This is a great time to join us!

The Role

Product development at Nabla is led jointly by Engineering and Product and organized into cross-functional squads. Each squad owns a product area end to end, with a product manager, a group of engineers, and the subject matter experts the work requires.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of the Dictation squad: a product that clinicians touch many times a day, that is critical to their day to day efficiency, and strategically pairs with Nabla's ambient product to cover all user settings.

This role sits at the intersection of ML, user experience, and customer success. You will work day to day with ML, backend, and frontend engineers on a product where model performance is only half the story. The other half is the interface, the latency, the recovery path when something goes wrong, and the dozens of small frictions that decide whether a clinician keeps using the product or quietly walks away. You will also be the one who pulls the right insight out of user feedback and supports the rollout of the product inside large health systems. Expect to reason about model quality and evaluation with your ML engineers one hour, then join a design review, dig through user feedback, or sit down with a client the next.

Above all, this is a role for someone with genuine curiosity about how clinicians work. You will spend real time with users, including regular visits to client sites in the US, watching how they move through their day and where our product costs them seconds they cannot spare. The best ideas here come from observation.

Nabla is growing fast and our users expect more of us every day. If you like owning a product end to end, care about the details, and want your work judged by whether clinicians actually adopt it, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

  • Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Nabla Dictation product, be accountable for its adoption and the quality-of-life improvements it delivers to clinicians.

  • Lead user-centric discovery: run interviews, dig into user feedback, shadow clinicians, and leverage usage data to find the frictions worth removing.

  • Work day to day with ML, backend, and frontend engineers to turn model capabilities into a product that becomes essential to clinician's day to day, making the trade-offs between quality, latency, cost, and time to market.

  • Partner with Design to make sophisticated technology feel simple, including the edge cases and failure paths that determine whether clinicians trust it.

  • Support deployment with our clients, including enterprise health systems: build strong relationships with Nabla champions and keep key stakeholders informed as the product evolves.

  • Define what good looks like: set the quality bar and the metrics that track it, from model performance through to adoption, retention, and support burden.

  • Prioritize ruthlessly between ambitious bets and the steady grind of removing friction, and be able to explain why.

Qualifications

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of product management experience in a technical or engineering-heavy environment.

  • Experience working closely with ML teams on products where model quality drives user value, and comfort discussing evaluation, quality metrics, and iteration loops with ML engineers.

  • Strong user empathy and a real appetite for diving deep into user workflows, with a track record of removing friction that others had accepted as normal.

  • Excellent product judgment and UX sensibility: you identify the high-value problems, define a strategy, and ship improvements users actually notice.

  • Proven ability to collaborate with frontend, backend, and ML engineers and to earn credibility with them.

  • Strong analytical skills: you define success metrics, read product data, and combine qualitative and quantitative evidence to decide.

  • Clear, structured communication, with the ability to explain trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences alike.

  • Comfort in a fast-moving environment with incomplete information, competing priorities, and high ownership.

  • Location and language: based in our Paris office, with regular travel to client sites in the US. Full professional fluency in English is required; French is a plus.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in healthcare, or in another regulated or safety-critical industry.

  • Experience with speech, real-time, or other latency-sensitive products.

  • Prior software engineering experience, or the ability to write scripts and reason about system logs, API schemas, and data models.

  • Experience with B2B products used every day in demanding frontline workflows.

  • Experience building for the US market.

Life at Nabla

When you become a part of our company, you join a team of excellence-driven, curious, and genuinely kind individuals. Together, we're committed to making clinicians' lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe in a world where clinicians can focus on what they were trained to do - caring for their patients, and where no patient feels their visit was rushed.

We come to work excited to leverage AI to do more for clinicians. We’re obsessed with our users’ satisfaction and we actively seek out opportunities to engage one-on-one with clinicians to understand how Nabla can better help. We consistently look for ways to improve and do not shy away from doing the work to excel. Whether it’s a feature our users asked for, or a new article for our blog, we prioritize collaboration to deliver exceptional outcomes.

We love having fun as much as we love work. Our #nablabla channel is as active as our #feature-show-off channel, we exercise during the work day at least 3 times a week (yoga, running, pilates, or HIIT, your choice!), enjoy regular off-sites to gather the team, and travel to see each other in places like NY, Paris, San Francisco, and many other vibrant cities. Oh, and we’re constantly snacking on chocolate or nuts!

If this sounds like an environment you’ll thrive in, we look forward to reading your application!

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.
