If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

The opportunity

We are looking for a Manager, Account Management, France to lead and develop a team of four Account Managers responsible for retaining, supporting and expanding Airwallex’s French customer base.

This is a highly hands-on player-coach role. You will own the team’s post-sale operating model across Onboard, Adopt, Prove Value and Expand, while remaining directly involved in strategic accounts, customer escalations, onboarding quality and expansion opportunities.

You will work closely with Sales, Onboarding, Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations to improve customer outcomes and make Airwallex easier to adopt and grow in France.

What you’ll do

Lead and coach the team

  • Manage and develop four Account Managers through focused 1:1s, account reviews, call coaching and development plans.

  • Set clear standards for account planning, stakeholder coverage, customer communication, CRM hygiene and commercial execution.

  • Improve individual performance through real customer situations, not activity reporting alone.

  • Build a team that can operate with increasing autonomy and consistent judgement.

Own customer outcomes and portfolio strategy

  • Segment the portfolio by customer value, complexity, risk and expansion potential.

  • Define the right coverage model: high-touch for strategic and high-potential accounts, more scaled motions for lower-complexity accounts.

  • Ensure priority customers have clear success outcomes, stakeholder maps, adoption plans and expansion hypotheses.

  • Improve the leading indicators of NRR: onboarding progress, time-to-value, product adoption, stakeholder coverage, customer health and expansion pipeline.

  • Improve the lagging outcomes: retention, GRR, NRR, satisfaction and advocacy.

Drive expansion and account growth

  • Build a repeatable, customer-led expansion motion across accounts, payments, FX, cards, Spend, payouts and related products.

  • Ensure expansion is based on validated customer needs, business triggers and demonstrated value—not product pitching alone.

  • Personally support strategic renewals, upsells, cross-sells and executive customer conversations.

  • Partner with Sales on handovers, pre-sales support and opportunities requiring specialist or new-business involvement.

Build the operating system

  • Create practical playbooks for onboarding, adoption, customer health, level 2 support, renewal and expansion.

  • Establish weekly reviews for risks, strategic accounts, escalations and expansion opportunities.

  • Improve visibility and predictability through clear CRM standards, account plans, health reviews and forecasting.

  • Build a closed-loop Voice of Customer process with Product, Operations, KYC, Risk and Support.

  • Turn recurring customer friction into process improvements rather than repeated individual escalations.

Orchestrate complex customer issues

  • Own the customer-facing coordination of important level 2 issues involving Support, KYC, Risk, Product or Operations.

  • Structure escalations with clear context, business impact, owner, next step and customer communication.

  • Influence internal teams to find workable solutions without bypassing controls or making unsupported commitments.

This role owns customer outcomes and orchestration. It is not a support queue-management role, and it does not replace the specialised ownership of Support, KYC, Risk or Compliance.

What success looks like

Within 90 days, you have mapped the portfolios, priority accounts, risks and expansion opportunities; established the team cadence; and created visibility on the main customer and operational issues.

Within 6–12 months:

  • priority accounts have clear plans, stakeholder coverage and next-best actions;

  • onboarding, adoption, escalation and expansion playbooks are consistently used;

  • leading indicators such as time-to-value, adoption, health coverage and expansion pipeline improve;

  • GRR, NRR, customer satisfaction and retention improve against an agreed baseline;

  • recurring customer issues are reduced through better processes and cross-functional ownership;

  • the four Account Managers show stronger autonomy, commercial judgement and consistency.

Who you are

  • 5+ years in Account Management, Customer Success, Sales, Expansion or a related B2B commercial role.

  • 2+ years of direct people management, ideally leading a team of 3–8.

  • Proven ownership of retention, renewals, expansion, adoption, customer health or comparable outcomes.

  • Experience working with NRR, GRR, churn, expansion, adoption, time-to-value or customer satisfaction metrics.

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments, banking, FX, spend management, ERP or another complex operational environment.

  • Strong customer-facing experience with Finance, Operations, Treasury, Procurement, E-commerce, founders or senior executives.

  • Evidence of building or improving customer processes, playbooks, account segmentation, health reviews, handovers or escalation routines.

  • Ability to influence Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations without direct authority.

  • Fluent French and professional English.

  • Strong commercial judgement, ownership and comfort working in ambiguity.

Preferred experience

  • Payments, fintech, banking, FX, cards, spend management or financial infrastructure.

  • KYC, AML, Risk, Compliance or regulated customer operations.

  • Strategic or multi-entity customers across France and international markets.

  • Pre-sales, onboarding design or solution development.

  • Travel, E-commerce, SaaS, Technology or Professional Services.

The profile we are looking for

You are a hands-on manager who enjoys customer conversations, coaches through real situations and creates structure where processes are not yet mature. You combine customer empathy with commercial discipline, solve root causes rather than simply escalating issues, and turn customer insight into better team performance and repeatable growth.

This is not a pure support-management role, a purely strategic Customer Success role or a passive relationship-management position.

The role reports to Paris regional leadership and is designed to combine strategic partner leadership, P&L ownership and organisation building across the Editions network.

As Account Management Lead – Editions France, you will lead the Editions commercial team for France constituted of Senior Account Managers, Account Managers and Sales Managers. You will be the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, accountable for its coordination and its execution on the ground, growing the performance and profitability of our sites while driving occupancy and the differentiation Editions brings to the French market.

You will own a portion of the Editions P&L. That means holding the commercial scorecard for new kitchens, making financial decisions with a clear view of both partner and Deliveroo profitability, and steering your team's portfolio towards sustainable growth rather than volume alone.

You will be accountable for the development plan for your team, their success and learning curve at Deliveroo; setting the right KPIs and OKRs to monitor the business. Your role will be commercially focused, however Editions is as much a project management discipline as a commercial one: you will work hand in hand with Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction, Kitchen Layout, Site Operations, Marketing and the International Editions team to bring kitchens live and keep them performing.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. 

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach. 

We have offices in Paris and London and we offer remote working from Germany, France and the United Kingdom.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will: 

  • Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and LinkedIn
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. description:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, building high-performing consumer products in mobile gaming. We're scaling a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players, and here, data isn't just analyzed, it's turned into systems that directly drive business performance.

As a Senior AI Data Expert (f/m/x), you'll operate at the intersection of data engineering, machine learning, data science, and analytics, building and scaling the data foundation that powers our entire business. This role combines all four data disciplines into one generalist position, you move to wherever the highest-value data problem is, rather than staying inside one lane. This isn't a role for maintaining pipelines or following predefined processes, we look for engineering mindset and entrepreneurial ownership: you build it, you own it, and you see the impact in production. AI is not a side tool here, it's core to how you work: you'll use Claude and similar AI tools daily to plan, build, debug, and document, including managing context and memory across projects, integrating AI directly into your version control workflow, and running parallel agent workflows on separate tasks, cutting repetitive tasks so you can focus where it actually moves the needle.

We believe a small team of engineers working closely with AI can outperform a much larger traditional data team, and we're building this role around that belief, not around AI as an occasional convenience.

If you're excited by complex systems, high traffic, and data-driven decisions, and impact matters more to you than process, we want to hear from you. We use AI for everything in order to improve speed and quality.

What You’ll Own:

  • Data Pipelines & Integration: You design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL pipelines on Databricks to integrate data from various sources, including app and web products and marketing partner data, ensuring reliable and efficient data flow across the business.

  • Data Lakehouse Ownership: You build and manage the Data Lakehouse on Databricks, including migrating legacy data products, and implement data transformations and processing logic using Databricks and PySpark.

  • Monitoring & Optimization: You monitor and maintain the data stack for nightly and near-real-time processing of in-house tracking solutions, continuously optimizing and troubleshooting pipelines to ensure data quality and integrity.

  • Analysis & Insight: You also turn open business questions into decision-ready analysis when that's where the highest-value work is, not just build the pipelines that feed it.

  • AI-Native Workflow: You use Claude and similar AI tools daily, not occasionally, to plan, build, debug, and document your pipelines, treating AI as a core part of the job rather than an add-on.

  • Version Control & Worktrees: You integrate AI directly into your version control workflow, using Git worktrees (or an equivalent) to run several AI-assisted branches of work side by side, rather than treating AI and your codebase as separate.

  • Context & Memory Management: You maintain structured project context for your AI tools, for example a CLAUDE.md-style instructions file, so they stay accurate and useful as pipelines and codebases grow, rather than relying on ad hoc prompts each time.

  • Parallel Agentic Work: You run multiple AI coding agents on separate tickets at the same time where it makes sense, reviewing and integrating their output rather than writing every line serially yourself.

  • AI-Assisted Communication: You're comfortable using AI to help manage day-to-day coordination, including in Slack, when it's the faster and more reliable way to keep things moving.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: You move fluidly across data engineering, machine learning, data science, and analytics work, depending on where the team needs you most, rather than staying fixed in one discipline.

  • Staying Ahead: You stay updated with industry best practices and emerging technologies in data engineering and applied AI, bringing new ideas and approaches to the team.


What You Bring

  • Technical Foundation: You have a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field, or bootcamp experience, with a minimum of 4 years of professional experience across data engineering, machine learning, data science, or analytics.

  • Cross-Disciplinary Range: You have real experience in at least two of data engineering, machine learning, data science, or analytics, and you're comfortable picking up the others as the role demands.

  • Current, Deep Databricks Experience: You are proficient in designing, implementing, and optimizing ETL processes on Databricks, with at least a year of current, hands-on depth, not brief or dated exposure.

  • Tools & Technologies: You have hands-on experience with Databricks and AWS services such as S3, Kinesis, and Lambda or similar technologies. Experience with GitLab CI/CD pipelines and familiarity with PostgreSQL are a plus.

  • Genuine AI Fluency: You use AI tools like Claude hands-on, daily, across planning, building, debugging, and documentation, not just for occasional testing. This is a core, non-negotiable part of the role, not a nice-to-have.

  • Context Engineering: You know how to set up and maintain project context and memory for AI coding tools, structured instructions and reusable prompts, so they stay effective as a codebase grows rather than relying on default settings.

  • Agentic & Worktree Fluency: You're comfortable running several tickets in parallel with AI assistance, using Git worktrees or a similar approach to keep parallel AI-assisted branches isolated and reviewable, and you can explain your actual workflow in detail rather than describing it as something that just happens automatically.

  • Programming Skills: You are highly proficient in Python, SQL, and PySpark for data manipulation and processing, and you write clean, maintainable, production-ready code.

  • Mindset & Communication: You have excellent problem-solving skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively. You are fluent in English, both verbally and in writing, comfortable letting AI take on a meaningful share of day-to-day coordination, and genuinely open to a way of working where AI reshapes how data teams operate, not just tolerant of it.


How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.

  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.

  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. “Not my job” isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.

  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.

  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

🌟 What we do & why we do it

Founded in 2021 in Osnabrück, Germany, doinstruct is on a mission to empower the backbone of our society - the frontline workforce - by making workplaces safer, more compliant, and more efficient. We don’t just improve training; we redefine how industries onboard and upskill their teams.

The problem? Outdated, inefficient training methods that fail to meet the needs of the deskless workforce - the 80% of global workers overlooked by traditional learning solutions. We saw the gap and built a seamless, mobile-first platform that makes onboarding, training, and compliance effortless, multilingual, and accessible - anytime, anywhere.

At doinstruct, we don’t accept the status quo. We innovate, we challenge, we build. Our vision is bold: Operational excellence for frontline teams starts here. We cut through the noise of clunky, ineffective training with an engaging, user-friendly experience available in 35+ languages - no downloads, no passwords - just instant access to the skills that drive industries forward.

🚀 Join us if you’re ready to build something extraordinary. We’re growing fast and looking for ambitious minds who thrive in a fast-paced, high-impact environment. If you’re passionate about solving big problems, shaping the future of workplace learning, and working alongside a driven team that moves fast and thinks big, doinstruct is where you belong.

___

The role

This is a hands-on role, requiring native-level German and working English proficiency.

doinstruct builds software that helps organizations train and enable their frontline teams, the people in factories, logistics, and service environments who are hardest to reach with conventional L&D. Our customers are manufacturers, industrial operators, and traditional enterprises.

As a key part of our marketing team, you’ll get to flex your strategic, research, and creative skills writing and creating content with two specific goals: Educate our audience (Thought leadership) and convert them (Acquisition). You own both end-to-end.

You will create high-value content in the form of blog articles, case studies, landing page copy, and white papers, collaborating closely with internal subject matter experts. For shoots and videos, you’ll use your storytelling superpowers to develop concepts and manage external production partners.

AI is an expected part of your workflow. You leverage the speed and efficiency technology affords with the taste only humans possess to create credible content worth reading.

If you have a journalistic curiosity, understand B2B audiences, and know how to build a content engine from the ground up - let’s talk!

🎯 What you'll own

  • Translate frontline realities, industry insights, trends, analysis, and product communication into content that resonates with buyers who don't live in generic SaaS marketing.

  • Plan and produce content across formats (website, blog, video, social) that performs in both traditional search and AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, and adjust based on what you’ve measured.

  • Use AI tools as your default production layer: drafting, repurposing, ideation, research, so you can ship more, faster, without sacrificing quality.

  • Produce German-first content (that’s also translated in English), and work closely with the wider GTM team on broader copy requirements like campaigns and sales decks.

  • Brand tone of voice, ensuring consistency and differentiation

🙋 Who you are

  • You've produced content professionally and have a portfolio or examples.

  • You have a journalistic mindset - able to interview subject matter experts to extract insights, hooks, and stories.

  • You're fluent in German, comfortable writing and speaking it professionally. You’re also comfortable collaborating, presenting, and working at a professional proficiency in English.

  • You’ve already restructured how you work around AI - whether that's tracking AI visibility with something like Profound or Peec AI, producing multilingual content with tools like ElevenLabs or HeyGen, or researching with Perplexity instead of defaulting to Google. (If your content workflow looks basically the same as it did two years ago, this probably isn’t for you.)

  • Bonus, not a requirement: you've worked with or around frontline, industrial, or blue-collar audiences and understand operator priorities.

🤩 What's different here

You're not maintaining an existing content machine; you're bringing a new brand strategy to life; experimenting; and building a content function. That means real ambiguity, but also a chance to have outsized impact on a rapidly scaling business.

🚀 Why doinstruct

  • 400+ customers, Series A funded, below 2% churn. The product is a genuine must-have, which gives you real stories to tell.

  • We're moving AI-first as a company and will actively help you get deeper into AI tooling, because that's the direction we're going.

  • You're joining a GTM org that's still forming its shape, so what you build sticks.

📈 What success looks like

3 months You've got a content production rhythm running across formats, you understand our frontline buyer personas firsthand, and you’re identifying opportunities.

6 months Content you've produced is showing up in AI answer engines for queries that matter to us, and you can point to the pipeline it's driving. You’ve established strong partnerships with stakeholders both internally and externally.

12 months There's a repeatable content engine that treats AI answer engines as a first-class channel alongside traditional search. Content is having a measurable impact on revenue.

____

At doinstruct, you'll have the chance to use your skills and help shape our growing start-up. We value a friendly work environment, open communication, and support your personal and professional growth every step of the way.

Even if you don't tick all of the boxes, but you are motivated and want to work with us, you are very welcome to apply.

We embrace diversity and hire people based on their ability to perform a job. People of any race, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, political opinion, or marital status are welcome at doinstruct.

_

Our core values shape how we work, ensuring consistency, trust, and purpose while guiding both individual actions and collective decisions. They’re not just words—we live them every day.

  • 💌 Appreciation – We cultivate an environment of mutual respect, recognizing the unique contributions and backgrounds of every team member. Success is a team effort, and we celebrate it together.

  • 💪 Drive – We don’t settle for "good enough." We are motivated by continuous improvement, setting ambitious goals, and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • 🚀 Enabler – We take a proactive, solution-oriented approach, understanding the diverse needs of both our customers and our team. We believe challenges are opportunities waiting to be solved.

  • 🗣️ Honesty – We value transparency and direct, constructive feedback. Open communication helps us learn faster, grow stronger, and build trust.

  • 🌟 Ownership – We take full responsibility for our work, moving with urgency and independence. We don’t wait for solutions—we create them. Mistakes are learning opportunities, and we embrace them as part of our growth.

 

🤝 How we work

We believe in a workplace culture that fuels ambition, fosters innovation, and rewards initiative. At doinstruct, you’ll be surrounded by driven individuals who are passionate about making an impact. We set high standards - because the work we do matters.

Collaboration and shared energy drive us. We believe that working together in person creates the best ideas, sharpens our execution, and strengthens our team. That’s why we thrive in an office-first environment, where we exchange ideas freely and move fast together.

We’re not about rigid structures - we’re about high performance with flexibility. While we empower every teammate to optimize their productivity, we also believe that great things happen when we’re in the same room, building something extraordinary side by side.

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

title: Marketing Manager (m/f/d)
description:
MAOMAO is a fast-growing online supermarket for Asian food, combining e-commerce with content, community and social commerce.

We don't just sell products. We introduce people to new foods, brands, trends and cultures through TikTok, Instagram, livestreams, TikTok Shop, our online shop and our own products.

As MAOMAO continues to grow, we're looking for a Marketing Manager (m/f/d) who wants to take real ownership and help shape the next stage of our marketing.

Aufgaben

What You'll Do

Campaigns & Product Launches

You will plan and coordinate marketing campaigns, promotions, product launches and livestreams from idea to execution.

This includes:

  • developing campaign and launch plans
  • creating timelines, responsibilities and deadlines
  • coordinating content and communication across our channels
  • making sure everyone involved knows what needs to happen and when
  • keeping projects moving and following up on deliverables
  • identifying problems and dependencies early
  • reviewing results and turning learnings into better future campaigns

We are looking for someone who thinks beyond individual tasks and takes responsibility for making the overall project work.

TikTok Shop & Social Commerce

Social commerce is an important part of MAOMAO and an area we want to continue developing.

You will work on:

  • TikTok Shop campaigns and promotions
  • Seller Center and campaign management
  • livestream campaigns and activations
  • product and promotional planning
  • coordination with TikTok and external partners
  • identifying and testing new opportunities in social commerce

Experience with TikTok Shop is a plus, but not a requirement. Curiosity and the ability to learn quickly matter just as much.

Marketing & Content

You will work with our team to develop campaigns and content around Asian food, products, trends and culture.

You will help decide:

  • which products and topics we should focus on
  • how we communicate them to our audience
  • which content formats and channels make sense
  • how campaigns connect across TikTok, Instagram, our online shop, email and other channels

We want someone who doesn't just create marketing, but increasingly understands why something works and how we can make it better.

Team & Project Coordination

Good ideas only matter if they get executed.

You will help coordinate marketing projects across the team, keep track of priorities and deadlines and make sure projects move forward.

Depending on your experience, you may also:

  • coordinate responsibilities within the marketing team
  • improve workflows and processes
  • support and guide other team members
  • take responsibility for larger marketing initiatives
  • help shape marketing priorities together with the founders

There is room to take on more leadership responsibility as both you and MAOMAO grow.

Your Role Can Grow With You

We don't expect one person to be an expert in every area of marketing.

Depending on your experience, strengths and interests, you can gradually take on additional responsibility in areas such as:

Performance & KPIs
Analyzing campaign performance, defining measurable goals and using data to improve marketing decisions.

Marketing Budgets
Managing defined budgets and deciding how resources should be allocated across campaigns and channels.

CRM & Email Marketing
Developing how we communicate with existing customers and improve retention.

What Ownership Means at MAOMAO

Ownership is one of the most important parts of how we work.

It doesn't mean working endless hours or having all the answers.

It means thinking beyond the individual task.

If we are launching a new product in four weeks, we don't want someone who simply waits for a list of things to do.

We want someone who thinks:

What are we trying to achieve? What needs to happen? Which channels should we use? What content do we need? Who owns what? What are the deadlines? What are we missing? What could go wrong? And how will we know whether it worked?

Just as importantly, we value people who think in solutions, not only in problems.

Pointing out that something is not working is useful. But we expect you to go one step further:

What can we do about it? What are the options? What can we test now? What is the fastest reasonable next step?

You should be willing to make informed decisions, experiment, learn from results and iterate quickly rather than waiting for a perfect answer.

Not every idea will work. That is okay.

What matters is that we learn fast, adjust fast and keep moving.

The mindset we're looking for is:

“Here is the problem. Here are the options. Here is what I recommend we try next.”

Qualifikation

Who We're Looking For

We're open to candidates with different backgrounds and levels of experience, but we're looking for someone who has already gained meaningful hands-on marketing experience and is ready to take ownership.

You should:

  • have at least 2 years of relevant experience in marketing, e-commerce, social media, content, campaign management or a related field
  • have fluent German skills (C1 or native-level), as you will be developing marketing for a predominantly German-speaking audience
  • have strong working proficiency in English
  • be highly organized, reliable and proactive
  • take initiative and think ahead
  • be able to turn ideas into structured plans and execution
  • communicate clearly and follow through
  • feel comfortable taking responsibility for outcomes
  • think in solutions rather than simply escalating problems
  • be willing to experiment, test and iterate quickly
  • be comfortable making decisions even when not every answer is obvious
  • have a strong interest in e-commerce, social media and social commerce
  • be comfortable working with data, KPIs and budgets
  • enjoy working in a fast-moving environment
  • be hands-on when needed
  • learn quickly and actively look for ways to improve

Experience in e-commerce, TikTok, TikTok Shop, social media, CRM, performance marketing or campaign management is a plus.

Chinese language skills are a plus but they are NOT a requirement.

Benefits

Benefits

What we offer

  • A central marketing role with a high level of ownership and room to shape how we work
  • Direct collaboration with the founders
  • Founders with backgrounds in venture capital and e-commerce
  • An existing marketing and content team to work with
  • Our own office, warehouse and content setup in Berlin
  • Short decision-making paths and the freedom to actually implement ideas
  • Plenty of room to experiment, test new formats and iterate quickly
  • The opportunity to work at the intersection of e-commerce, social media, TikTok Shop, livestreaming and brand building
  • The opportunity to shape campaigns and launches from idea to execution instead of owning only one small part of the process
  • Clear professional and personal development opportunities, including the potential to take on more leadership responsibility
  • A young, international team with a lot of passion and team spirit
  • Employee discount across our assortment

Interested?

Send us your CV and a short introduction telling us why you want to join MAOMAO and what excites you about this role.

We'd also like you to answer one question:

Tell us about a marketing campaign, project or experiment you took ownership of. What was your goal, what did you do, and what was the result?

It doesn't have to be a huge campaign or a perfect success. We're interested in how you think, how you approach problems and what you learn from the things you try.

One last thing: We don't mind if you use AI to help with your application – we use AI too. But if your application could be sent to 50 other companies by simply replacing the company name, it's probably not for us. Show us why MAOMAO, and show us how you think.

If you want to take ownership, move fast and help us grow a category that has been treated as a niche for far too long, we'd love to hear from you.

Maybe you're the Sriracha to our noodle soup. 🌶️🍜

title: Lead Implementation & Delivery (f/m/d)
description:
We're looking for an experienced implementation, delivery or technical operations lead to own delivery after a contract is signed — and to play a central role in working out what actually makes our product work for customers.

This one is for you if:

  • You'd rather build the playbook than wait for one to exist
  • You get real satisfaction from being the person people can count on — customers and colleagues alike
  • Making a genuinely complex, technical product work in the real world, on a factory floor and not just a slide deck, sounds like a good problem to have

Every factory should be as easy to redesign as a CAD file. RIIICO scans real production floors and turns the raw point cloud into a structured, living model of the plant — machines, robots and infrastructure recognised by AI, matched to CAD, usable directly in the engineering tools our customers already run. Line changes that used to take months of manual work now take days.

We're seed-funded, backed by Earlybird, PiLabs and seed + speed, with angels including Joe Kaeser, former CEO of Siemens.

Team: two application engineers report to you directly, and you steer our data delivery team, which has its own manager and five people.
Start: as soon as you can.

Tasks

You'll own the entire post-sale delivery, from signed deal to a customer who's live, confident and getting real value. Our customers are enterprise manufacturers, so the accounts you own are complex and technically demanding from day one. As an early hire there's no existing playbook — expect to blend hands-on implementation, delivery operations and testing product-market-fit hypotheses directly with customers.

  • Own the post-sale journey, from handover through to stable, value-delivering adoption
  • Build the adoption framework for enterprise accounts, and define what "first value" means
  • Keep a current view of every account: check-ins, early risk signals, retention plans
  • Handle escalations yourself, at both operational and management level
  • Own the Sales-to-delivery handover and keep capacity visible and realistic
  • Develop the lightweight processes that make delivery repeatable as patterns emerge
  • Lead and develop your team, and shape how Delivery is structured as we grow
  • Test the product-market-fit hypotheses Sales brings back, and feed findings into Product and Go-To-Market

What this looks like in your first six months:

  • Months 1–2 — run two live enterprise implementations yourself, end to end, so you know where the product and the process actually break
  • Months 2–3 — take over the Sales-to-delivery handover and make capacity visible enough that Sales doesn't promise what delivery can't back up
  • Months 3–4 — define what "first value" means for an enterprise account, and the timeframe we hold ourselves to
  • Months 4–6 — turn what you've learned into the first delivery playbook, and bring at least two validated product-market-fit findings back to Product and Sales

Requirements

  • 4–6 years in technical implementation, delivery, project lead or technical operations roles, at a B2B company serving manufacturing or industrial customers
  • Experience as an early hire building implementation or delivery processes from scratch in a startup or scale-up
  • Experience owning the interface between Sales and a technical delivery team: handover, capacity oversight, and escalations you resolved independently
  • Enough technical depth to get fluent fast in discrete manufacturing, factory planning or industrial automation. You don't need to have done this exact thing before, but you do need to hold a credible conversation with a manufacturing engineer within a few months

You'll fit if:

  • You're decisive and comfortable holding your ground when Sales pushes on scope or timeline — and just as good at negotiating a pragmatic trade-off without compromising commitments already made
  • You're pragmatic and action-first: you build the process as the pattern emerges, rather than designing the system before you understand the reality
  • You have commercial instinct: you notice what's working and bring it to Sales as an expansion opportunity
  • You're a fast learner with strong situational awareness, equally comfortable on a shop floor and in front of a senior stakeholder

Benefits

  • Real ESOP — actual shares, not virtual ones
  • 30 days' holiday
  • Deutschlandticket
  • Based in our Düsseldorf office, with the flexibility to work from home
  • Regular customer site visits — a genuine mix of factory floor and desk, not travel every week
  • Real ownership from day one, with a direct line to founders and leadership on decisions that matter
  • The chance to define what this function becomes as we grow
  • A diverse, international team

Apply with your CV — no cover letter needed.

  1. Short intro call — 30 minutes
  2. Written questions by email — about 20 minutes of your time

  4. Meet the team, then offer

The written questions are how we get to know how you think before anyone sits in a room. They're the reason we don't ask for a cover letter.

As Head of Accounting & Tax, you own the entire accounting function of the Roadsurfer Group and lead your team through a period of real change. You report directly to the CFO and you are part of a finance organization that brings together Accounting & Tax, Controlling, FP&A, Corporate Finance, and Finance Operations.

The Role - Your Passion

  • You lead the accounting function of the roadsurfer Group and are responsible for reliable, timely, and audit-proof monthly financial reporting.

  • Together with your (group) accountants you are responsible for the preparation of the annual financial statements and group financial statements under German GAAP (HGB).

  • You are the key contact for auditors, tax advisors, and authorities, and you steer the annual audit process.

What you need to ride the wave with us

  • Min. of 10 years of relevant accounting experience, including responsibility for (group) financial statements under German GAAP (HGB) and proven leadership of an accounting team.

  • A strong accounting qualification, such as a degree in finance/accounting or a comparable certification.

  • Good understanding in German tax law.

  • Experience with SAP and finance transformation projects; ideally, you have supported a SAP implementation or migration from an accounting perspective.

  • A structured, hands-on leadership style with the ability to build scalable processes in a dynamic environment.

  • Curiosity for automation, AI-supported finance workflows, and data-driven process improvements.

  • An eye for detail, a positive mindset combined with a solution focus - you're someone who leads by example.

  • Fluent in English and German.

As a Technical Writer at Camunda, you'll be embedded within product teams, taking full ownership of documentation for key areas of our platform. You'll join a collaborative, mission-driven team focused on helping developers become productive with Camunda technologies quickly and joyfully. Developers with technical writing experience are encouraged to apply.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  1. Own and drive the documentation for one or more product areas, acting as the embedded technical writer within the corresponding product teams.

  2. Maintain and improve our documentation site's technical infrastructure, including build tooling, deployment pipelines, and Docusaurus platform configuration, to keep publishing fast, reliable, and scalable.

  3. Work closely with engineers, product managers, and designers to stay deeply informed about the product roadmap and ensure documentation is accurate, timely, and aligned with feature development.

  4. Become a subject matter expert in your assigned product areas, developing hands-on experience with Camunda products to create documentation that reflects real-world usage and developer needs.

  5. Lead documentation efforts from concept through to release, including planning, writing, reviewing, and maintaining content that empowers developers to succeed with Camunda technologies.

  6. Advocate for documentation as a critical part of the user experience, bringing the user’s perspective into product discussions and influencing design and implementation where appropriate.

  7. Continuously improve the structure, clarity, and completeness of the documentation based on analytics, user feedback, and your own insights.

  8. Collaborate with other writers and the broader Documentation team to share best practices, contribute to team goals, and evolve our documentation tooling and standards.

What You Bring:

  • 3+ years of technical writing experience and a strong portfolio of developer-focused content such as user guides, installation guides, API references, tutorials, and technical blog posts.

  • Proven experience of maintaining, troubleshooting, configuring, and extending documentation site infrastructure and deployment pipelines, preferably using Docusaurus.

  • Hands-on experience with Java, Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, and related technologies, and a proven ability to deeply understand, use, and test complex technical products (ideally with Camunda 8 or similar products).

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

title: Werkstudent EV Sales & Deal Operations (m/w/d)
description:
Über Aampere

Werde Teil von Aampere, einem Seed-Stage VC-backed Startup, das den europäischen Markt für gebrauchte E-Autos neu definiert. Wir ermöglichen es EV-Besitzer:innen, ihr Fahrzeug innerhalb von 48 Stunden zu verkaufen, und verschaffen Händlern in ganz Europa Zugang zu neuen Kundensegmenten. Der Markt ist fragmentiert, intransparent und schwer vertrauenswürdig, deshalb bauen wir die Infrastruktur, die das ändert, damit mehr Elektroautos ein zweites Leben bekommen und der Wandel zur Elektromobilität wirklich an Fahrt aufnimmt.

Und es funktioniert: Wir steigern unseren Umsatz Jahr für Jahr um das Vierfache und halten bereits mehr als 1 % des deutschen Consumer-EV-Wiederverkaufsmarkts. Unser Team kommt aus der deutschen Startup-Szene und der Automobilwelt, mit Erfahrung bei Autarc, Limehome, Cardino, Wemolo, Alasco, Porsche, Mercedes und KPMG.

Die Stelle ist ab sofort zu besetzen. Wenn du etwas bewegen möchtest, dann werde Teil unseres Teams.


Deine Mission

Du hast Lust auf direkten Kundenkontakt, gehst gerne auf Menschen zu und Autos sind für dich nicht einfach nur Fortbewegungsmittel, sondern ein echtes Interesse? Dann bist du bei uns im Sales Team genau richtig. 

Operativer Vertrieb: Du unterstützt unser Sales Team dabei, Fahrzeuge für die Auktion vorzubereiten: von der Prüfung der Daten bis hin zur finalen Aufbereitung für die Plattform.
Prozessbegleitung: Du begleitest unsere Verkäufer:innen durch den gesamten Verkaufsprozess. Vom ersten telefonischen Kontakt bis zur Planung der Übergabe sorgst du dafür, dass intern alles reibungslos läuft.
Sales-Prozesse weiterentwickeln: Du analysierst bestehende Abläufe, bringst Ideen ein und hilfst mit, unsere Prozesse schlanker, effizienter und skalierbarer zu gestalten.
Feedback für Produkt und Team: Du gibst Erkenntnisse aus dem Kundenkontakt weiter und hilfst so, unser Produkt gezielt weiterzuentwickeln.
Startup-Alltag: Du bringst dich dort ein, wo du gebraucht wirst, mit deinen individuellen Stärken und Interessen.


Das bringst du mit

Dein Background: Du bist aktuell immatrikuliert im Bachelor- oder Masterstudium. Dein Studiengang ist für uns zweitrangig, viel wichtiger sind deine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und dein Blick für saubere Prozesse.
Kommunikationsstärke: Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, telefonierst gerne und fühlst dich im direkten Kundenkontakt wohl.
Interesse an Autos: Kein Muss, aber definitiv ein Plus, denn du wirst viel mit Fahrzeugdaten arbeiten.
Entrepreneurial Mindset: Du hast Lust auf ein Umfeld, in dem sich Dinge schnell bewegen, zeigst Eigeninitiative und willst aktiv mitgestalten statt nur Dienst nach Vorschrift zu leisten.
Verfügbarkeit: Du hast 20 Stunden pro Woche Zeit für uns, in den Semesterferien gerne mehr.
Sprachkenntnisse: Du beherrschst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) und Englisch sicher in Wort und Schrift.


Why Aampere?

Wachstum & Ownership: Du bekommst vom ersten Tag an echte Verantwortung, triffst eigene Entscheidungen und wirst als vollwertiges Teammitglied behandelt: im schnelllebigen Umfeld kannst du entsprechend schnell aufsteigen. Student steht auf dem Vertrag, nicht auf deiner Rolle.
Urban Sports Club oder Job Ticket: healthy team, happy team
Late Dinner im Office: Wenn es abends länger wird, übernehmen wir dein Dinner (Uber Eats)
Offsite: bis jetzt waren wir am Lago Maggiore, in den Alpen und am Tegernsee, what's next?
Wohnen im Werksviertel: Im angrenzenden Co-Living Space gibt es die Möglichkeit, eigenständig ein Zimmer zu mieten: direkt neben dem Aampere-Büro und mit Blick auf das Riesenrad.
Chance auf Übernahme: Wenn du besonders gut bist, wollen wir, dass du bleibst. Denk von Anfang an nicht daran, wo das endet, sondern wo es hinführen könnte.


Aampere ist nichts für dich wenn...

...du überwiegend remote arbeiten willst. Wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen entstehen, wenn Menschen im selben Raum sind.
...du fertige Prozesse und Strukturen vorfinden willst. Bei uns gibt es vieles davon noch nicht. Wir suchen Leute, die Strukturen und Prozesse selbst bauen, statt sie zu verwalten.

Made loud.

Was du hier machst

Immotalente besetzt kaufmännische Stellen in Hausverwaltungen. Dahinter läuft ein selbstgebautes System: Kandidaten werden gefunden, bewertet und angeschrieben, über sechzehn Mandate hinweg. Dazu ein Wissensspeicher, in dem Mandate, Kunden und Abläufe liegen und aus dem heraus KI-Agenten arbeiten.

Du schließt Lücken im Bestand. Echte Fahrzeiten statt geschätzter. Datenprüfungen vor dem Import. Ein Abnahme-Test, der vor jeder Freigabe läuft.

Und du prüfst, was du gebaut hast. In diesem System sind Fehler unsichtbar: eine Spalte hat fünf Wochen nichts gerechnet, während die Oberfläche „100 Prozent fertig" anzeigte. Wer hier baut, ohne hinterher das Verhalten zu prüfen, richtet mehr Schaden an als Nutzen. Das ist die eine Regel, die nicht verhandelbar ist.

Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründer. Keine Ebene dazwischen, keine Abstimmungsrunden.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

Du hast schon etwas gebaut, das funktioniert hat. Ein Skript, ein Automatisierungs-Workflow, ein Werkzeug mit einer KI dahinter, irgendetwas, das ein Problem gelöst hat, das nicht deins war. Zeig es uns, das zählt mehr als jede Note.

Zusammen mit Claude & Co kommst du mit JSON und einer REST-Schnittstelle klar und schreibst kleine Skripte, in JavaScript oder Python. Du schreibst sauberes Deutsch und merkst, wenn ein Satz nach Maschine klingt. Du hast die Angewohnheit, nach einer Änderung nachzusehen, ob sie wirklich umgesetzt wurde, statt der Erfolgsmeldung zu glauben.

Welches Fach du studierst, ist zweitrangig. Immobilien- oder Recruiting-Vorkenntnisse brauchst du nicht. Sie sind hilfreich, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Benefits

  • Du arbeitest mit dem aktuellen Werkzeugkasten: Claude, Clay, n8n, Lemlist, Recruiterflow, eigene HTML-Werkzeuge. Nichts davon ist Spielzeug, alles davon ist im Einsatz.

  • Du bekommst ein Zeugnis mit Zahlen darin, nicht mit Aufgabenlisten. Was du gebaut hast, was es eingespart hat, was du gefunden hast.

Wie es weitergeht

Melde dich über diese Anzeige. Erzähle von dir und wann dein Praktikum starten muss, wie lange es geht, und ein Link oder Screenshot von etwas, das du gebaut hast. Zwei Sätze dazu, was daran schwierig war.

Wir antworten innerhalb von drei Werktagen.

  • Background in better-for-you food, functional food, private-label NPD, or a fast-growing consumer brand.

  • Experience delivering products into D2C and retail channels across DACH or Europe.

Working at ahead is more than just a job - it’s your opportunity to develop as a professional and as a person, while shaping the future of snacking. Our mission is to make low sugar the new standard, and we pour that ambition into every product we create. You’ll become part of a team where international talent, startup drive, real impact, and true ownership come together.

title: Senior Process Engieer
description:
ABOUT US

tozero is Europe’s leading deep-tech startup specializing in the recycling of
lithium-ion batteries. Committed to accelerating decarbonization and transforming
the material life cycle, we’re actively crafting sustainable recycling solutions for a
cleaner and more innovative future.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a Senior Process Engineer to take a leading technical role in the
design, scale-up, commissioning and ramp up of our battery recycling processes.
This role sits at the intersection of technology development, process engineering,
and industrial scale-up. You will translate experimental and operational data into
robust process designs, challenge engineering assumptions, and ensure that our
future plants are built on solid fundamentals.
Your focus will be on the processes that matter most to our technology — graphite
and lithium extraction. By working closely with R&D, Operations and external
engineering partners, you will actively lead and engage in activities associated with:
a) engineering design; b) commissioning and ramp up; c) process development.
We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a production
environment, but who can also take a step back and understand what the data is
telling us, and engineer the process we need at different scales.


WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

Must Have's:
1. Future Plant Design & Scale-up
● Own key process design activities for our next-generation plants.
● Develop and review PFDs, P&IDs, mass and energy balances, process
descriptions and equipment specifications for future capacity expansions.

● Translate pilot and industrial operating data into reliable engineering design
criteria and scale-up assumptions.
● Perform process calculations and equipment sizing to ensure our future
plants are designed based on validated engineering data rather than
theoretical assumptions alone.
2. Targeted Process Expertise & Optimization
● Become a technical reference for some of our most critical process steps.
● Apply strong chemical engineering fundamentals to the optimization of
graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing.
● Identify the parameters controlling yield, purity and process stability and
translate these insights into concrete process improvements.
● Work closely with R&D and Operations while maintaining a strong focus on
process performance and technology development rather than daily
troubleshooting.
3. Data Analysis & Process Modeling
● Turn plant data into engineering decisions.
● Evaluate operational and experimental data, build and validate mass balances
and process models, and identify gaps between expected and actual process
performance.
● Define what data needs to be collected to support future scale-up decisions.
● Technically guide data analysts and other engineering functions to ensure
that models and analytics remain grounded in physical and chemical reality.
● Translate analysis into clear recommendations for process upgrades and
future plant designs.
4. Commissioning & Process Validation
● Make sure what we designed actually works.
● Participate in FATs/SATs, commissioning activities and process performance
validation for new equipment and plant expansions.
● Develop acceptance and process validation criteria based on the original
design intent.
● Evaluate commissioning and operational data to confirm that installed
systems achieve their calculated performance targets.
● Work closely with Operations during handover while ensuring clear ownership
transfers once the process meets its design criteria.
5. Operational Readiness, Process Safety & SOPs
● Design processes that can be operated safely and consistently.
● Translate process design and engineering intent into clear Standard Operating
Procedures (SOPs), operating envelopes and process documentation.
● Participate actively in HAZOPs, LOPAs, and other process safety reviews,
ensuring that process risks are identified and addressed during design rather
than after installation.
● Support Operations in understanding the design basis and critical process
parameters of newly commissioned systems.

Nice-to-have's:
Vendor & EPC Coordination
● Represent tozero's process requirements with external engineering partners
and equipment suppliers.
● Prepare and review technical specifications, vendor proposals and engineering
documentation.
● Challenge unsupported assumptions, identify over-engineered solutions and
ensure equipment is correctly sized for our process.
● Support technical bid evaluations and equipment selection, balancing process
performance, CAPEX, operability and scalability.
● Act as a strong technical counterpart to EPCs, engineering contractors and
equipment vendors throughout project execution.


Your profile

You have a strong chemical/process engineering foundation and enjoy solving
technically complex problems with a combination of first-principles engineering and
real plant data.
● Degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Metallurgical
Engineering or a related technical field.
● Ideally 5+ years of experience in process engineering within the chemical,
hydrometallurgy, battery, mining, minerals, recycling or related process
industries; specific expertise in graphite and lithium extraction and
post-processing is highly preferred.
● Strong experience with process design and scale-up, including PFDs, P&IDs,
mass/energy balances and equipment sizing.
● Comfortable working with industrial datasets and translating operational data
into engineering models and decisions.
● Experience with solid-liquid separation, precipitation, flotation,
hydrometallurgy or mineral processing is highly valuable.
● Able to critically review vendor proposals and confidently challenge technical
assumptions.
● Strong experience supporting commissioning and process validation of
industrial equipment or plants.
● Familiarity with process safety methodologies such as HAZOP and LOPA.
● Comfortable moving between detailed calculations, engineering
documentation and the actual plant.
● Strong communicator who can work effectively across R&D, Engineering,
Operations, suppliers and EPC partners.
● Fluent English; German is a plus.


Why us?

Our technology is moving from first-of-a-kind industrial operations toward
increasingly larger and more standardized plants.
The Senior Process Engineer will help us make that transition successfully: turning
what we learn from today's plant into the engineering basis for tomorrow's plants
while supporting commissioning and ramping up efforts.
You will directly influence process performance, equipment selection, CAPEX and the
technical architecture of our future facilities — helping ensure that every new scale is
safer, simpler, more efficient and better engineered than the one before it.

title: Content Marketing Manager (all genders)
description:
Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Companies like EDEKA, AmRest (Starbucks, KFC, La Tagliatella), Nordsee, Hermes or even big Testing, Inspection and Certification bodies rely on Lumiform to keep standards consistently high across hundreds of locations and shifts.

We think writing will increasingly be handled by AI. Knowing what to write about will not, and neither will writing something that is actually worth reading. The value moves to the person who can build two kinds of knowledge fast.

First, the topic. What a HACCP verification actually involves in a restaurant chain, why a bakery fails a hygiene audit, what a fleet manager is dealing with when hundreds of vehicles need daily checks across a country. The problems, the standards, the vocabulary, the things that go wrong. Second, the product. What Lumiform actually does, how logic, scoring, offline capture and workflow automation work, and where the product genuinely solves that specific problem versus where it does not. You build both by reading primary sources, watching customer demos and talking to the people in sales and success who hear these problems every day. The content that wins is written where those two meet.

On top of that sits original research. This is our biggest growth bet, and it will be yours to own. Benchmark reports that give this category a reference point it currently does not have, shared with industry bodies and journalists. You come up with the angle, find the data and build something worth citing.

This is a research and expertise role that ends in writing, not a writing role that starts with a prompt. You go deep, get technical, learn faster than seems reasonable, then produce content that reads like a human wrote it.

Tasks

Your core mandate sits on four priorities.

1. Topic ownership and expertise

  • Own assigned topic areas and content clusters. Within weeks you are the person in the company who knows the most about your topics.
  • Build that knowledge from primary sources, customer demos and conversations with sales and success.
  • Know the product properly and be able to adapt it to specific use cases and competitor comparisons.

2. Benchmark reports and original research

  • Our biggest growth bet. You come up with the ideas, define the angle and decide what is worth measuring.
  • Research internal and external data and build reports at an academic level of rigor that hold up when a journalist or industry body checks them, then work with the marketing managers to get them in front of the right people.

3. Content production

  • Write app use pages that show exactly how Lumiform works for a specific industry use case, from HACCP and fire safety to vehicle inspections.
  • Write listicles, competitor comparison pages and best-alternative pages that position Lumiform clearly against each competitor and around topics.
  • Write customer stories based on real interviews, plus newsletters and other marketing materials.

4. Publishing and maintenance

  • Publish and manage content in WordPress, applying SEO and AEO fundamentals.
  • Improve existing content on quality, relevance, structure and performance.
  • Use actual data from demos and customer calls to turn them into FAQs and on-page answers, so the website handles objections before a prospect asks one of our reps.

Requirements

Required

  • 4+ years in content marketing, meaningful time spent in B2B SaaS
  • A smart mind with a top university degree
  • Native-level English writing. This role produces English content for an international audience and the bar is publication quality.
  • Proven independent research. You have found data, worked with primary sources, judged what is reliable and built something original out of it. Bring examples.
  • You develop expertise fast. Hand you an unfamiliar regulated topic on Monday and you can hold a credible conversation with a practitioner by Friday
  • Technical curiosity. You want to understand how a product actually works and which problems it solves.
  • You are able to use AI properly. It accelerates research and drafting, and the output is never final. You revise, restructure and add what the model cannot, which is judgement, a point of view and a reason the piece exists.
  • You write clearly, creatively and in an approachable, human way. No filler, no throat-clearing, no AI slop.
  • You bring your own ideas. You propose topics and reports rather than waiting for a brief.
  • Reliable, diligent and proactive. You take ownership of your work, meet deadlines and pay close attention to accuracy, quality and consistency.

Strongly preferred

  • Experience building benchmark reports, surveys or other original research content
  • Familiarity with WordPress
  • Basic SEO understanding, including keyword research, keyword integration, headings, internal linking and content optimisation
  • You have already heard of AEO (answer engine optimization) and understand why it matters. It is our biggest growth engine.
  • Experience writing about regulated or technical subjects such as food safety, quality, EHS or logistics

Benefits

About Lumiform

Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Customers are mid-size and large companies such as multi-site retailers, restaurant chains, logistics fleets, warehouse operators, construction businesses and manufacturers. Companies like EDEKA, AmRest, Virgin Media and even testing, inspection and certification bodies rely on Lumiform. Rated 4.6 on G2, Lumiform is built in Europe, offering full data sovereignty and GDPR compliance.

Why working with us

  • You are part of a company that has a positive impact on society. We protect frontline workers and customers from preventable harm.
  • Join an ambitious, international team with flat hierarchies and real decision-making autonomy. You work closely with two marketing managers and directly with our founders.
  • Own a growth bet from scratch. Benchmark reports will carry your name and go out to industry bodies, journalists and analysts.
  • Go deep on subjects most marketers never touch. You leave here knowing more about inspections, audits and frontline operations than almost anyone in the market.
  • Work fully remote and choose where you get things done

If this sounds like you, let's talk. A CV or LinkedIn profile is enough. If you have written something you are proud of, a benchmark report, a deeply researched piece, anything that took real work, send it along.

Our Hiring Process

  • Screening call (30 minutes) with HR
  • First interview (general get to know call) with founder (30 minutes)
  • Second interview (deep dive interview) with founder
  • We ask you for 2 references and will conduct reference calls (as a final step)

About TACTILIA

The Role

As a Senior Sensor Engineer (Tactile & Proprioception) at TACTILIA Robotics, you will build the neural architecture of physical touch and spatial awareness that gives our robotic hands human-like dexterity.

You will own the complete sensing architecture—from evaluating tactile technologies and proprioceptive layouts to designing readout electronics, calibration matrix algorithms, and real-time sensor pipelines.

Fitting high-density sensing skins, force feedback, and position tracking into a tight hand envelope means balancing signal integrity, low latency, and mechanical durability under high cyclic wear. You will work closely with Mechanics, Electronics, and Software to turn raw physical contact into clean, reliable data for real-time robotic control.

What you will do:

  • Own the sensing architecture. Lead the evaluation, selection, and overall design of tactile and proprioceptive sensing systems across fingers, palm, and joints—built for modularity across product variants, not a one-off prototype.

  • Develop tactile array hardware. Design and prototype high-resolution tactile sensors (optical, capacitive, piezoresistive, or magnetic) tailored for space-constrained, contact-rich finger pads and palm surfaces.

  • Engineer proprioceptive feedback. Implement joint- and drive-level feedback mechanisms, including high-precision position/angle sensing, strain gauge force bridges, load cells, and tendinous tension tracking.

  • Design readout electronics & AFEs. Build low-noise analog front-ends (AFEs), signal conditioning circuits, and local readout hardware optimized for minimal latency, wide dynamic range, and high immunity to electromagnetic interference (EMI).

  • Build calibration & processing pipelines. Implement automated calibration protocols, thermal/drift compensation matrix algorithms, and feature extraction (e.g., slip detection, contact point estimation) to feed clean telemetry to the software stack.

  • Characterize & validate on real hardware. Own sensor testing on custom rigs—evaluating dynamic response, force linearity, hysteresis, spatial resolution, and long-term mechanical wear over hundreds of thousands of cycles.

  • Drive sensor manufacturing & yield. Partner with specialized suppliers on Design for Manufacturing (DFM) for flexible/rigid-flex PCBs, molded tactile skins, and elastomeric components, ensuring high assembly yield and second-sourcing.

  • Work across the whole team. Tight loop with Mechanics (for load paths and physical packaging), Electronics (for board interfaces), and Software (for state estimation and closed-loop grasp control).

What you bring:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics, Sensorics, Robotics, or a related field.

  • 5–10 years of experience developing sensor hardware, mechatronic instrumentation, or sensor fusion systems, including at least one product taken into series production.

  • Deep domain expertise in tactile sensing modalities (e.g., optical tactile/GelSight style, piezoresistive, capacitive) or high-density proprioceptive feedback (encoders, strain gauges, load cells).

  • Proven experience in analog circuit design, signal conditioning (AFE), active filtering, and high-SNR data acquisition for physical sensors.

  • Hands-on experience with sensor calibration techniques, thermal/hysteresis modeling, signal processing, and standard communication buses (SPI, I2C, CAN).

  • Practical experience designing or integrating flexible PCBs, molded elastomers, or miniaturized mechatronic assemblies into tight physical envelopes.

  • A strong hardware mindset: you enjoy lab bring-up, sensor characterization on test rigs, and tracing physics-to-signal anomalies with scopes and logic analyzers.

  • Fluent in English; German is a plus, not a requirement.

Bonus:

  • Background in real-time embedded C/C++ firmware or ROS/ROS2 for sensor data processing and filtering.

  • Experience with tactile algorithms for slip prediction, texture recognition, or contact shape estimation.

  • Experience with soft robotics, stretchable electronics, or conductive polymers.
