Your creative field

At GPORTAL, our vision is to build individual and easy-to-use online gaming experiences for the world. Driven by our “from gamer for gamer” passion, we've grown into one of the leading game server providers - offering more than just servers, unlike other hosting companies. For over 20 years, we've been bringing virtual worlds into people's homes with just a few clicks. Our mission: enabling experts and beginners alike to play their favourite games together with their friends. From Palworld and Enshrouded to Minecraft and Battlefield, we offer around 100 multiplayer games across every genre.


GPORTAL is looking for a Director Marketing who is ready to take the wheel of our entire marketing department, performance marketing, social media, partner management, community management, and graphic design. Reporting directly to our CEO, you will be part of the core management team from day one, with the kind of ownership over people and KPIs you will not find in every gaming company.

In your first six months, the priority is simple: keep the team running strong while you get a real feel for GPORTAL's business, our vision, and where we are headed. You will take full budget responsibility, from managing current spend and staying on top of marketing invoices to building the annual forecast. You will also size up the market to derive strategic conclusions on where we push next.

From there, you settle in as a driving force in our management team and sharpen how the marketing department works so it is well set up for the future. That includes working hand in hand with our tech teams on product-related topics such as checkout flows or game updates and launches. You also take full responsibility for onboarding, managing, and offboarding our external agencies and freelancers. On top of that, you build real connections with the marketing team over at Contabo Group to create synergies wherever possible. Just as important: brand visibility and closeness to the community. GPORTAL is a love brand to its players, and that needs to show up in the social channels and communication tools where our community actually lives.

Alongside that, you own our marketing campaigns with partner studios and the big moments like Black Friday. Last but not least, you advise our CEO directly on D2C pricing based on comprehensive market assessments, both the operative calls today and the strategic thinking further out.

Longer term, you push the KPIs that matter and build retention measures that keep players around. You also shape a team structure that can scale with us. That also means preparing and presenting marketing reporting and KPIs at Group and shareholder level. And you run and assess customer surveys, turning what you learn into decisions we actually act on.

Gaming is a volatile business, and the classic playbook does not always deliver a straight line to growth. We are all pulling for the same outcome for the wider group, which sometimes means short-term compromises we make together. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager (ISR) (f/m/x) to own the product and delivery side of LiveEO's defence and intelligence business. Sektion 4 builds AI-based ISR capabilities for German and allied defence and intelligence customers: object and change detection in very high resolution satellite imagery, 3D terrain products derived from stereo imagery, and the analytics that turn imagery into decisions. You will be part of Sektion 4, LiveEO's government-solutions product team. Sektion 4 owns its roadmap and delivers funded R&D projects and defence engagements end-to-end, from research through to production, and sets its own technical direction. title: Senior Consultant Search, Content & AI Visibility (SEO/GEO) (m/w/d), München
description:
Wofür wir stehen:

“We drive digital transformation end-to-end - from strategy to execution. Creating measurable progress and real impact for our clients.”
 
Stillstand? Nicht mit uns. Wir glauben: Alles ist BETA und genau darin liegt die Chance für Fortschritt. Darum hinterfragen wir Bestehendes, wagen Neues und gestalten die digitale Transformation unserer Kunden aktiv mit.
Was uns auszeichnet? Wir denken ganzheitlich. Von der strategischen Beratung bis zur Implementierung begleiten wir unsere Kunden End-to-End – mit Kreativität, technologischer Exzellenz und einem tiefen Verständnis für ihre Geschäftsmodelle. So entstehen messbarer Fortschritt und nachhaltiger Impact.
 
Und jetzt kommst du: Wir suchen Menschen mit Neugier, Ambition und dem Mut, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Menschen, die Lust haben, Neues zu lernen, unsere Kunden zu begeistern und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen.


Deine Aufgaben:

Deine Mission: Suche hat sich in zwei Jahren mehr verändert als in den zehn davor. Unsere Kunden, B2B Hidden Champions aus Manufacturing, Industrial Goods und Wholesale, 300 Mio. bis 5 Mrd. EUR Umsatz, merken das gerade: organischer Traffic bricht ein, obwohl die Rankings stabil sind. Recherchen beginnen immer häufiger auch in ChatGPT, Perplexity und Google AI Mode statt ausschließlich auf der Suchergebnisseite. Du machst diese Marken in klassischer Suche und in generativen Systemen sichtbar. Der Hebel dafür ist Content: Sichtbarkeit entsteht heute über Inhalte, die Suchintention treffen und zitierfähig sind, nicht über Keyword-Dichte. Du gibst die inhaltliche Richtung vor und sorgst dafür, dass die Sichtbarkeit belegbar ist, nicht behauptet.

  • Strategie über die gesamte Suchlandschaft: Du entwickelst Search- und Content-Strategien, die klassisches SEO und GEO/AI Search zusammenführen, statt sie als zwei Projekte zu behandeln. Du priorisierst nach Impact, nicht nach Vollständigkeit.
  • Technisches SEO in der Tiefe: Crawling, Indexierung, Core Web Vitals, JS-Rendering, Logfile-Analyse, internes Verlinkungs- und Informationsdesign. Du begleitest Relaunches und Migrationen so, dass danach nicht die Sichtbarkeit fehlt.
  • Content-Strategie und Entitätsarchitektur: Du entwickelst Themen-, Content- und Entitätsarchitekturen entlang der B2B Buying Journey von Awareness-Content für die frühe Recherche bis zu Deep-Content, aus dem LLMs zitieren. Du entscheidest, welche Themen besetzt werden, welche Formate es braucht und was bestehender Content leisten muss.
  • Content steuern, nicht schreiben: Du briefst unser Content-Team und die Fachexpert:innen unserer Kunden, reviewst gegen Suchintention und Zitierfähigkeit und entscheidest, was publiziert wird. Du baust Content-Audits, findest Kannibalisierung und Substanzlücken und leitest daraus einen Redaktionsplan ab, der auch in sechs Monaten noch trägt. Die Texte schreiben andere. Die Richtung gibst du.
  • AI Visibility aufbauen: Du arbeitest an konsistenter Entitätsdarstellung (strukturierte Daten, sameAs, Wikidata, Branchenverzeichnisse), an zitierfähigen Inhalten und an Präsenz in den Quellen, aus denen LLMs tatsächlich zitieren.
  • AI Visibility messbar machen: Prompt-Set-basierter Share of Voice über ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot und Google AI Mode – inklusive Auswertung von GPTBot-, OAI-SearchBot- und PerplexityBot-Zugriffen in den Logfiles. Referral-Traffic aus generativen Quellen trennst du so weit, wie die Datenlage es zulässt, und dokumentierst die Grenzen der Messung offen.
  • Audits mit Konsequenz: Du führst SEO- und GEO-Audits durch, analysierst Wettbewerb und Suchintentionen und leitest daraus priorisierte Maßnahmen ab, die jemand am Montag anfangen kann.
  • Verantwortung im Retainer: Du steuerst mehrere Kundenaccounts parallel, arbeitest in vereinbarten Stundenbudgets, führst die monatlichen Reporting-Calls und Quarterly Reviews und flaggst Scope-Themen früh statt spät.
  • Beratung auf Augenhöhe: Du präsentierst auf Management-Level, bist Sparringspartner:in für Marketing- und Digital-Verantwortliche und sagst auch die unbequeme Wahrheit, wenn die Lieblings-KPI nichts über das Geschäft aussagt.
  • Neugeschäft mitgestalten: Du unterstützt bei Pitches und Angeboten, schätzt Aufwände realistisch ein und bringst dein Fachthema in Kundengespräche ein, bevor das Projekt startet.
  • AI-native im eigenen Handwerk: Du nutzt LLMs und Automatisierung für Analyse, Content-Optimierung und Reporting – und weißt, wo AI-Output eine fachliche Prüfung braucht.
  • Wissen weitergeben: Du coachst Kolleg:innen und Kunden, arbeitest eng mit Content, Performance und mit deinem Analytics-Pendant zusammen und dokumentierst so, dass Setups auch nach einer Übergabe noch tragen.


Damit kannst Du punkten:

  • Erfahrung mit Substanz: Mindestens 5 Jahre in SEO – mit echter Projektverantwortung, nicht nur Zuliefern. Du hast Setups gebaut, die noch tragen, nachdem du das Projekt abgegeben hast.
  • Technisches SEO ist dein Zuhause: Du kannst ein Setup mit fünfstelliger URL-Zahl auditieren und die Findings priorisieren. Search Console inkl. API ist dein Tagestool, dazu Screaming Frog, Logfiles und eine der gängigen Suites (Sistrix, Semrush oder Ahrefs).
  • Content-Kompetenz auf Steuerungsebene: Du hast Content-Strategien für erklärungsbedürftige B2B-Themen verantwortet, inklusive Themenarchitektur, Redaktionsplanung und Qualitätssicherung. Du schreibst Briefings, die ein Redakteur versteht, reviewst Texte gegen Suchintention und Zitierfähigkeit und erkennst, wann ein Text fachlich zu dünn ist, um in generativen Antworten zu bestehen. Selbst schreiben musst du nicht.
  • GEO-Erfahrung oder GEO-Neugier: Du hast schon an AI-Sichtbarkeit gearbeitet – oder du hast dich so ernsthaft eingelesen und ausprobiert, dass du eine fundierte Meinung dazu hast. Zum Beispiel dazu, ob llms.txt überschätzt ist. Wir erwarten keine fünf Jahre Erfahrung in einer Disziplin, die es seit zwei Jahren gibt.
  • Datenkompetenz, ohne Analytics-Rolle: Du liest GA4 und Search Console sicher, kannst mit BigQuery-Exports arbeiten und formulierst, welche Messung du brauchst. Bauen muss sie ein anderer – aber du weißt, was du bestellst.
  • B2B-Verständnis: Du weißt, dass eine 9-monatige Buying Journey mit sechs Beteiligten andere Antworten braucht als ein D2C-Shop. Projekterfahrung in Manufacturing, Industrial Goods, Maschinenbau oder Wholesale ist ein Plus.
  • Analytisches Denken mit Mut zur Aussage: Du erkennst Muster und traust dich, daraus eine klare Empfehlung abzuleiten – auch wenn sie nicht die bequeme ist.
  • Kommunikation: Du erklärst einer Geschäftsführung, warum eine Entitätsstruktur eine Investition wert ist. Souverän, ohne zu vereinfachen.
  • Hands-on und geduldig mit Kundenrealität: TYPO3-Installationen von 2014, eine IT, die sechs Wochen für ein Deployment braucht, ein CMS ohne Zugriff auf die Meta-Ebene. Du kennst das und arbeitest trotzdem an Ergebnissen. Bei Unklarheiten holst du dir gezielt den nötigen Input aus dem Team und arbeitest anschließend eigenständig und zuverlässig weiter.
  • Excel beherrschst du im Schlaf
  • Sprachen: Kommunikationsstark in Deutsch und sicher in Englisch.


Was wir von Dir benötigen:

Mission started?! Dann brauchen wir von Dir:   

  • Deinen CV
  • Welche Vergütung Du Dir für Deine Performance vorstellst
  • Deine Kündigungsfrist bzw. möglicher Starttermin


Warum wir?

Wir glauben: Wer viel gibt, soll auch viel zurückbekommen. Deshalb erwarten dich bei uns Benefits, die über „Extras“ hinausgehen. Sie geben dir Freiheit, Flexibilität und die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln, und machen deinen Arbeitsalltag einfach besser.

  • Teamspirit pur: Kollegiale Teams mit echtem Zusammenhalt, Hilfsbereitschaft und einer guten Portion Humor.
  • Transparente Strukturen: Flache Hierarchien und eine gelebte Open-Door-Mentalität - Austausch auf Augenhöhe ist selbstverständlich.
  • Open Vacation Policy: Neben deinen gesetzlichen Urlaubstagen kannst du dir mit unserer „Above & Beyond“-Regelung zusätzliche freie Tage gönnen.
  • Work from anywhere: Ob Home-Office oder temporär im Ausland - du entscheidest, wo du am produktivsten bist.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Großer Gleitzeitrahmen - du bestimmst deinen Rhythmus, mit Verlässlichkeit bei Kunden- und Teammeetings.
  • Modelle, die zu deinem Leben passen: Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, fix oder zeitlich begrenzt – wir finden gemeinsam die passende Lösung.
  • Spannende Projekte, innovativ, abwechslungsreich und mit steiler Lernkurve – bei uns gestaltest du echten Fortschritt mit.
  • Wachstum garantiert: Individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget für Workshops, Zertifizierungen oder Coachings.
  • Karrierepfade: Auch bei flachen Hierarchien sorgen klare Strukturen für deine Weiterentwicklung.
  • Mobility & Events: Bis zu 467 € fürs Öffi- oder Deutschlandticket, regelmäßige Teamevents und Besuche von Messen & Conventions.
  • Loft-Offices: Zentral gelegen, modern ausgestattet, kreativ – mit Raum für Austausch, Ideen und natürlich Snacks & Drinks.
  • Rewards: Prämiensystem für deine persönlichen und unternehmerischen Erfolge.

Diese Position ist im Consulting Cluster von TOWA auf Senior-Level angesiedelt. Das Gehalt liegt zwischen €60.000 und €75.000 brutto/Jahr (All-in). Die angegebene Range umfasst alle Gehaltsbestandteile und ist als Zielgehalt zu verstehen (z. B. inklusive variabler Anteile oder weiterer Benefits, sofern zutreffend). Im Falle einer Zusammenarbeit erstellen wir dir ein individuelles Angebot – die Einstufung innerhalb der Range richtet sich nach deinen Skills, deinem Verantwortungsbereich und deiner Erfahrung, niemals nach deinem vorherigen Gehalt.

Im Einklang mit der EU-Entgelttransparenzrichtlinie (2023/970) und den länderspezifischen Gleichbehandlungsgesetzen veröffentlichen wir für jede Rolle die Gehaltsspanne und fragen Kandidat:innen nicht nach ihrem aktuellen oder vorherigen Gehalt. Unsere Kriterien zur Gehaltsfestlegung – Cluster, Level, Skills, Verantwortungsbereich und Erfahrung – gelten unternehmensweit einheitlich. Du kannst während des gesamten Prozesses jederzeit schriftlich weitere Informationen zur Gehaltsspanne dieser Rolle oder zu unserer Vergütungspolitik anfordern.

Chancengleichheit

TOWA stellt nach Skills und Impact ein. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen aller qualifizierten Personen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Hintergrund, Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder Behinderung. Die Stellenbezeichnung gilt für alle Geschlechter (m/w/d).

description:
Location: Remote, CET-2 to CET+2

Hours: Part-time, 20 hours per week, ideally spread across four or five weekdays

Start: As soon as possible

You will own the people side of MultiBase for a small, international consulting team. Your primary focus is making sure colleagues feel heard, supported and clear about their development. Recruitment is a secondary responsibility when hiring needs arise.

This is a hands-on standalone role with no direct reports, reporting directly to the management.

About MultiBase

MultiBase is a specialist business intelligence and analytics consultancy, founded in 1991. We work with mid-sized companies across Germany, Austria and Switzerland to turn data into profit. MultiBase has delivered more than 1,500 projects for over 400 clients.

We are around 20 people, working remotely across Germany, Romania, India, Brazil, Pakistan and South Africa. English is our working language. We are building an AI-accelerated consulting business with its own products.

Tasks

Your role

You will create a consistent people rhythm for the team: regular contact, development conversations, onboarding, goals and skills records. You will spot issues early, listen well and bring senior management practical recommendations.

When we hire, you will run a reliable recruitment process and give candidates a professional experience. You work independently within agreed criteria and bring senior management a clear recommendation when approval is required.

People management and development

  • Build regular contact with the team and provide a trusted, discreet point of contact.
  • Run quarterly development conversations, independently or with the management.
  • Make sure every colleague has clear, current goals in Sage HR and a current skills record in MuchSkills.
  • Own the new-starter experience so that each remote joiner has a strong start
  • Identify people issues early and bring management a practical recommendation.
  • Make sure agreed actions, development commitments and important conversations are properly documented.

Recruitment

  • Own approved searches from vacancy brief to signed contract when hiring is required.
  • Write and publish adverts, manage applications, screen candidates and hold structured first conversations.
  • Run the hiring process: application, culture test, case study and interview with management.
  • Coordinate external recruiters where needed and keep each search moving.
  • Give every candidate a meaningful update within two working days after each stage.
  • Decide early-stage progression and rejections within agreed criteria.

How you will work with our German office team

You own people management, candidate communication, development rhythm, onboarding experience, employee contact, goals and skills records.

Our backoffice owns personnel administration, employment-contract administration, payroll inputs, absence records, local compliance and coordination with external counsel. You coordinate each new starter's onboarding together.

AI and automation will reduce routine administration. You remain accountable for quality, confidentiality and sound judgement in people matters.

Requirements

What you bring

  • At least three years in HR, recruitment or people operations, ideally in a small company, scale-up or agency.
  • Experience holding development conversations and building trusted relationships with colleagues.
  • Proven experience running recruitment processes: screening, structured first conversations, candidate communication and pipeline management.
  • Strong organisation and documentation discipline.
  • Sound judgement with confidential employee and candidate information.
  • Cross-cultural awareness and fluent business English, written and spoken. This is essential.
  • Practical daily use of AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude, with careful review of outputs.
  • A reliable remote setup and at least three to four working hours of overlap with Central European working hours.
  • Residence between CET-2 and CET+2, with the right to work in your country of residence.

Useful, but not required: German proficiency. If candidates are equally strong overall, German capability is an advantage. Experience hiring data, BI or software professionals. Experience with Sage HR, MuchSkills or similar tools. Experience in a distributed international team.

What success looks like

After 3 months: You know every team member's role, goals and current development commitments. The quarterly review cycle has a clear date, owner and template. New joiners have a consistent and positive first-two-week experience.

After 6 months: Goals and skills records are current. Team members know where to raise concerns and development needs. When a search is active, candidates get clear answers within days and the process moves without senior management chasing it.

Benefits

What we offer

  • Direct access to the management and real ownership of a function.
  • A part-time role with meaningful responsibility.
  • Budget for the AI tools you need for your work.
  • Competitive compensation, discussed individually.

How to apply

Apply with your CV and tell us which country you live in. No cover letter is needed. Bonus: include a short paragraph about one people or recruitment situation you handled: what happened, what you did and what you learned.

Our process includes a short practical case study before the interview with senior management. We read every application and respond to every candidate.

Über thexton armstrong

Die Beratungsgesellschaft thexton armstrong ist ein internationales Netzwerk selbständiger Partner, spezialisiert auf die Begleitung von Geschäftsinhabern im Mittelstand und auf Wachstumsberatung. Seit 2012 haben unsere Partner mehreren tausend Geschäftsinhabern geholfen, Ertragskraft, Widerstandsfähigkeit und den langfristigen Wert ihrer Unternehmen zu steigern. Grundlage ist eine strukturierte Methodik, die praktische Führungserfahrung mit messbaren Ergebnissen verbindet.

Wir sind selbst Unternehmer. Jeder Partner führt seine Gesellschaft in einem exklusiven Gebiet und greift zugleich auf die Methodik, die Werkzeuge und das Wissen des gesamten Netzwerks zu. Wir sind in den Niederlanden, Belgien, Süddeutschland, der Schweiz und Großbritannien tätig und bauen jetzt Nord- und Ostdeutschland auf.

Aufgaben

Ihre Perspektive

  • Regionales Wachstum verantworten: Sie gründen und führen Ihre Beratungsgesellschaft unter der Marke thexton armstrong mit exklusiven Rechte für ein Gebiet in Nord- oder Ostdeutschland.
  • Unternehmen im Mittelstand voranbringen: Sie helfen Unternehmern versickerte Gewinne zu lokalisieren und in ins Unternehmen zurückzuführen. Mithilfe der proprietären thexton armstrong Programme befähigen Sie Unternehmer und Ihre Teams dauerhaft Wachstum, Ergebnis und Unternehmenswert zu steigern und Strukturen zu verbessern.
  • Langfristige Mandate aufbauen: Ihre Mandanten arbeiten mit Ihnen über monatliche Retainer, in der Regel über zwölf Monate und oft über Jahre. Mit fünf bis zehn Mandanten parallel entsteht ein Geschäft mit planbarem Rhythmus. Dazu bauen Sie ein Empfehlungsnetzwerk aus Steuerberatern, Banken und anderen Partnern auf.
  • Das Gesicht der Marke in Ihrer Region sein: Sie vertreten thexton armstrong gegenüber Unternehmern, Verbänden und Multiplikatoren und gestalten Marketing und Veranstaltungen gemeinsam mit der Regionalorganisation.
  • International zusammenarbeiten: Sie tauschen sich mit Partnern in fünf Ländern über Mandate, Methoden und Erfahrungen aus.

Qualifikation

Ihr Hintergrund

  • mindestens 15 Jahre Berufserfahrung mit Führungs- und Ergebnisverantwortung, als Geschäftsführer, Bereichs- oder Abteilungsleiter, als Unternehmer oder Mitgesellschafter, als Interim Manager oder Unternehmensberater
  • Führungserfahrung in mehreren Funktionen, etwa Vertrieb, Marketing, Finanzen, Business Development oder Operations
  • nachweisbare Erfolge in der Steuerung von Unternehmensergebnissen, im Aufbau von Geschäftsfeldern oder in der Begleitung von Unternehmen
  • idealerweise B2B-Erfahrung im deutschen Mittelstand und ein Netzwerk in Ihrer Region

Ihre Kompetenzen und Ihre Haltung

  • strategisches und kaufmännisches Urteilsvermögen
  • unternehmerischer Anspruch mit langfristiger Perspektive
  • die Fähigkeit, mit Geschäftsführern und Inhabern Beziehungen aufzubauen und Vertrauen zu gewinnen
  • die Bereitschaft, die Gewinnung von Mandanten selbst zu verantworten
  • unabhängig, belastbar, an Ergebnissen orientiert, pragmatisch und authentisch
  • Deutsch fließend in Wort und Schrift auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (Pflicht), gutes Englisch und Wohnsitz in Nord- oder Ostdeutschland
  • finanziell in der Lage, eine Anlaufphase zu überbrücken und den Ausbau des eigenen Geschäfts zu tragen

Benefits

Warum mit thexton armstrong?

  • Erprobtes System: mehr als ein Jahrzehnt Erfahrung mit messbaren Ergebnissen für Mandanten und Partner. Der Erfolg unserer Mandate ist durch die Langen Laufzeiten der Mandate dokumentiert auf eine intensive erste Phase von 12 – 18 Monaten folgt eine weniger aktive Phase, die oftmals über Jahre läuft.
  • Schlüsselfertiges Geschäftsmodell: Live und online Onboarding workshops verteilt auf zwei Monate, Methodik, Online-Werkzeuge, Vorlagen und ein Startprogramm für die Mandantengewinnung.
  • Unterstützung bei der Lead-Generierung: In der Startphase unterstützen wir Sie bei der Gewinnung von Erstkontakten zu Geschäftsinhabern, damit Sie schneller zu ersten Gesprächen kommen und Ihr Mandantenstamm zügiger wächst.
  • Geringe Fixkosten, hohe Autonomie: Sie arbeiten vom Homeoffice oder einem Regionalbüro aus, ohne zusätzliche Personalkosten, und entscheiden selbst über Tempo und Umfang des Ausbaus.
  • Begleitung und Kollegenkreis: laufende Begleitung durch die Regionalverantwortlichen und ein internationales Netzwerk von Partnern mit vergleichbarem Hintergrund.
  • Exklusives Gebiet: Ihr Gebiet ist Ihnen exklusiv zugeordnet; Sie bauen darin Ihren eigenen Mandantenstamm und Ihr eigenes Netzwerk auf. Aktiv akquirieren Sie in Ihrem Gebiet; Mandanten von außerhalb, die von sich aus auf Sie zukommen, dürfen Sie ebenfalls betreuen.

At Bliq, we are building and launching driverless vehicles for everyday life and business operations across Europe.

We are looking for a Account Executive to help bring them to customers.

Our customers can look very different. One week, you may be discussing a fleet deployment with a taxi or car-sharing company. The next, you may be showing the vehicle to a real-estate company, law firm, mobility operator, or prospective individual customer.

This is not a role where you inherit a mature market, established category, and optimized sales playbook. Driverless technology is only getting started in Europe. You will need to understand unfamiliar customer problems quickly, figure out how Bliq can solve them, and help us discover how this technology should be sold.

You will work closely with the Commercial Lead and founders to refine Bliq’s sales playbook market by market.

  • Experience selling hardware, mobility, automotive, physical technology, or other operationally complex products is a strong plus

This role will probably not suit you if you want an established sales process, a narrowly defined territory, a predictable product demo, or a manager telling you exactly what to do next.

title: System Software Engineer (gn) Cloud & Simulation
description:
Your mission

At Wandelbots, we are building NOVA, a platform that makes industrial robot programming accessible to everyone. Our Simulation team develops the technologies that allow partners, customers, and internal teams to work with photorealistic digital twins of real production environments.

This includes a pipeline that transforms real-world scans into usable 3D scenes through Gaussian Splatting, as well as a browser-based streaming platform built on NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim. Both technologies work today, but neither is yet operated as a product. Your mission is to change that.

The first step is internal standardization. We want to replace individually maintained environments and hand-crafted deployments with one reproducible, documented solution that teams can use independently: scene in, session out, without requiring the Simulation team to operate every setup.
The second step is external productization. The same capabilities need to be packaged so that partners and customers can operate them in their own environments. 
E.g. with versioned releases, stable interfaces, tenant isolation, diagnostics, upgrade paths, and documentation.

You will join the Simulation team and focus on the infrastructure and operational foundations of these systems. You will not be building them in isolation: Wandelbots has an established infrastructure team responsible for shared infrastructure and platform capabilities. You will work closely with that team while owning the simulation-specific workloads, deployment patterns, and operational requirements.

This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape architecture and make technical decisions in collaboration with the teams involved.

What you will work on

  • Build and operate the GPU infrastructure required by our simulation workloads, including NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, driver lifecycle, and GPU sharing through MIG or time slicing

  • Work with the infrastructure team to integrate simulation workloads into our shared Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure

  • Make deployments declarative and reproducible using Infrastructure as Code and GitOps, and help consolidate the tooling used across today’s environments

  • Own CI/CD and the container and image lifecycle for CUDA- and NGC-based workloads

  • Design scheduling and autoscaling for two distinct workload profiles: latency-sensitive interactive streaming sessions and compute-intensive Gaussian Splatting jobs

  • Turn the Gaussian Splatting pipeline into a reproducible workflow, from data capture and training to OpenUSD assets

  • Operate and extend our Omniverse and Isaac Sim streaming platform, including Kit App Streaming, session lifecycle, and tenant isolation

  • Establish the platform as an internal standard through self-service workflows, golden paths, templates, onboarding, and documentation

  • Prepare the solution for operation by partners and customers through packaged deployments, versioned releases, upgrade paths, and actionable diagnostics

  • Support deployments across cloud, on-premises, and partner-managed environments

  • Build meaningful observability using metrics, logs, GPU telemetry, and actionable alerting

  • Define the simulation-specific security and access model, including ingress, TURN and STUN for WebRTC, RBAC, secrets management, SSO, and tenant boundaries

  • Work closely with our robotics, product, and platform teams to ensure that the solution supports real development and customer workflows



Your profile

We are looking for an engineer who is interested in how complex systems are built, deployed, and operated, not only in delivering the next application feature.
You should bring:

  • Experience building or operating production systems in platform engineering, infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or systems software

  • Practical Kubernetes experience, including resource management, workload scheduling, and debugging distributed systems under load

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and CI/CD, together with the ability to evaluate tools based on the problem rather than a fixed preference

  • Solid knowledge of Linux, containers, and networking

  • Good Python skills for automation, services, and data-processing workflows

  • Experience with GPU workloads, or a strong technical foundation and clear interest in working with drivers, CUDA, and GPU scheduling

  • The ability to turn working technology into a system that other teams can use independently

  • A strong sense of operational ownership, including documentation, diagnostics, maintainability, and reproducibility

  • Very good English; German is a plus


We do not expect candidates to have prior experience with every technology in this description. A strong systems foundation, the ability to learn unfamiliar components, and an interest in this problem space are more important than matching every item. The scope and responsibilities of the role will grow with your experience.


Nice to have

  • Experience turning an internally developed system into a product that can be operated in customer-controlled environments

  • Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim, Kit SDK, or OpenUSD

  • Experience with Gaussian Splatting, NeRF, photogrammetry, or comparable 3D reconstruction pipelines

  • Knowledge of WebRTC, pixel streaming, or other low-latency video technologies

  • Python, Rust, or Go skills sufficient to contribute to existing services and infrastructure tooling

  • Experience with robotics or simulation, such as ROS 2 or sim-to-real workflows

  • Experience with multi-tenant platforms, air-gapped deployments, or customer environments with specific security and compliance requirements



Why us?

Make an impact!
Work on an innovative, deep tech product that adds value to the robotics world and to society! Become a crucial part of something new, big and exciting where you can truly make an impact!

Our teams inspire!
Cross-functional communication is key. You'll get to know many of your 100+ colleagues. Collaborate with great people on our international teams who value knowledge sharing and unique ways of doing things!

Be authentic!
Work in a value-driven environment where everything may not be perfect, but we're working on it! Your feedback is required while you receive feedback and appreciation for your work!

Help others!

Develop yourself!

And there is even more!
Enjoy our free lunch, snacks and drinks, team events, 30 days of annual vacation + additional rest during Christmas season until New Year. If your child gets sick, we assure that a 100% of your usual earnings will be paid while you take care of your little one.

title: Senior Rollout Manager (f/m/x) – DACH
description:
Your mission

IONITY baut ein europaweites Netzwerk von High-Power-Ladestationen auf und betreibt dieses. Als Senior Rollout Manager übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung mehrerer Ladestandorte in der DACH-Region – von der Rollout-Planung und der Standortvorbereitung über die Bauphase, Inbetriebnahme und Abnahme bis zur Übergabe an Operations. Du überführst komplexe, funktionsübergreifende Projekte in einen planbaren und verlässlichen Rollout neuer Standorte.
Die Rolle verbindet Projektmanagement, Infrastrukturentwicklung und Stakeholder-Management. Du koordinierst interne Teams, Behörden, Grundstückseigentümer, Netzbetreiber, Baufirmen, Installationspartner und spezialisierte Partner auf gemeinsame Meilensteine, Entscheidungen und Qualitätsstandards. Deine Arbeit leistet einen direkten Beitrag zum Wachstum des europäischen IONITY Netzwerks, sowie einem zuverlässigen Ladeerlebnis für Elektrofahrzeugfahrerinnen und -fahrer aus ganz Europa. Jede neue Ladesäule als Ergebnis deiner Arbeit beschleunigt die Verkehrswende und ist ein wichtiger Beitrag für eine emissionsfreie Mobilität.

  • Du übernimmst die ganzheitliche Verantwortung für die Umsetzung eines Portfolios von HPC-Ladestandorten in der DACH-Region, mit besonderem Fokus auf die komplexesten, risikoreichsten oder strategisch wichtigsten Standorte. Über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus hinweg steuerst du Umfang, Zeitplan, Abhängigkeiten, Risikoexponierung, Kostenrisiken, Qualität, Sicherheit, Compliance und die betriebliche Umsetzungsreife.
  • Du übersetzt die Rollout-Ziele in integrierte Standort- und Portfolioumsetzungspläne, definierst Prioritäten, Reihenfolgen, Meilensteine und Abhängigkeiten und stellst eine klare Governance sicher – von der Standortentwicklung und Genehmigungsplanung über die Bauphase und Inbetriebnahme bis zur Übergabe an den Betrieb.
  • Du führst die funktionsübergreifende Umsetzung über die Bereiche Planung und Genehmigung, Bau, Netzanschluss, Logistik etc. hinweg, treibst zeitnahe Entscheidungen voran, löst Konflikte und stellst sicher, dass kritische Schnittstellen zwischen Grundstück, Tiefbau, Elektrotechnik, Netzanschluss, Installation der Ladehardware, Prüfung und Inbetriebnahme aktiv gesteuert werden.
  • Du steuerst externe Planungsbüros, Auftragnehmer, Installationsunternehmen und weitere Umsetzungspartner direkt, setzt klare Erwartungen, überwachst die Leistung, steuerst die operative Umsetzung sowie kommerzielle Risiken und stellst sicher, dass die Partner die vereinbarten Ergebnisse liefern.
  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für das Risiko-, Änderungs- und Maßnahmenmanagement des Portfolios, identifizierst kritische Risiken frühzeitig, definierst Gegenmaßnahmen und führst Wiederherstellungspläne für verspätete, blockierte oder erheblich vom Plan abweichende Standorte. Dabei schützt du Umsetzungsqualität, Sicherheit und Compliance.
  • Du triffst Entscheidungen innerhalb deines übertragenen Verantwortungs- und Entscheidungsrahmens und erstellst klare Entscheidungsvorlagen für den Country Manager DACH, sofern eine Eskalation erforderlich ist. Du stellst tragfähige Optionen, Auswirkungen und Empfehlungen dar und wägst dabei Zeitplan, Kosten, Qualität, technische Machbarkeit und die Anforderungen der Stakeholder gegeneinander ab.
  • Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu Behörden, Netzbetreibern, Grundstückseigentümern, lokalen Stakeholdern und Umsetzungspartnern auf und pflegst diese, vertrittst IONITY auch in komplexen Gesprächen professionell und löst Genehmigungs-, Netzanschluss-, Grundstücks-, Bau- und sonstige Umsetzungshindernisse pragmatisch.
  • Du erstellst prägnante und entscheidungsorientierte Berichte für Senior Stakeholder, einschließlich Fortschritt, prognostizierter Termine, Prognosesicherheit, wesentlicher Risiken, Kosten- und kommerzieller Risiken, Partnerleistung, Maßnahmen zur Planwiederherstellung sowie der erforderlichen Entscheidungen, um das Portfolio auf Kurs zu halten.
  • Du etablierst und verbesserst kontinuierlich Rollout-Standards, Governance-Routinen, Vorlagen und Umsetzungsleitfäden. Auf Basis gewonnener Erkenntnisse erhöhst du die Planbarkeit, Qualität, Skalierbarkeit und Umsetzungseffektivität des Rollouts im gesamten DACH-Netzwerk.


Your profile

  • Du bist ein Teamplayer und arbeitest auch unter Zeitdruck mit einem hohen Anspruch an Qualität.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d)

Du kennst den Unterschied zwischen einer geschalteten Anzeige und einer funktionierenden Recruiting-Strategie? Und du willst nicht nur eine Position im Haus besetzen, sondern die Personalgewinnung ganzer Unternehmen verantworten? Dann lies weiter.

Im klassischen Inhouse-Recruiting arbeitest du an den Stellen, die dir zugewiesen werden, mit dem Budget, das jemand anderes verhandelt hat. Bei uns läuft es umgekehrt: Du entscheidest, welche Unternehmen du gewinnst, wie ihre Recruiting-Strategie aussieht und über welche Kanäle die Besetzung läuft. Beratung, Umsetzung und Ergebnis liegen in einer Hand – deiner.

Aramaz Digital ist eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung im Zentrum von Bielefeld. Wir machen Arbeitgeber sichtbar und liefern ihnen planbar passende Bewerbungen – über datengetriebene Kampagnen statt Zufallstreffer. Fachkräftemangel und demografische Entwicklung lassen diesen Markt jedes Jahr weiter wachsen.

Deine Verantwortung

Strategie und Beratung

  • Du analysierst, warum die Personalgewinnung eines Unternehmens nicht liefert – Zielgruppe, Positionierung, Kanäle, Prozessgeschwindigkeit.

  • Daraus entwickelst du eine belastbare Recruiting-Strategie und stellst sie den Entscheidern vor.

  • Du gewinnst neue Kunden aktiv: über Telefon, Direktansprache und Empfehlungen.

Kampagnen und Besetzung

  • Du planst Recruiting-Kampagnen, steuerst sie über die Laufzeit und justierst anhand der Zahlen nach.

  • Du prüfst eingehende Bewerbungen, führst Erstgespräche zur Vorauswahl und gestaltest eine Candidate Experience, die im Gedächtnis bleibt.

  • Bis zur erfolgreichen Besetzung bleibt das Projekt in deiner Hand.

Daten und Weiterentwicklung

  • Du arbeitest sauber im CRM, kennst deine Kennzahlen und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.

  • Gemeinsam mit Marketing und Geschäftsführung schärfst du unsere Methodik weiter.

Dein Profil

  • Recruiting-Verständnis: Du weißt, wie Zielgruppenansprache, Kanalauswahl und Prozessgestaltung zusammenwirken – ob aus Agentur, Personaldienstleistung oder Inhouse.

  • Beratungsstärke: Du triffst mit deinen Fragen den Kern, denkst in Lösungen und erklärst sie so, dass Entscheider mitgehen.

  • Vertriebsbereitschaft: Neue Kunden zu gewinnen gehört für dich dazu und schreckt dich nicht ab.

  • Zahlenaffinität: Du liest Kampagnendaten, erkennst Muster und handelst danach.

  • Eigenverantwortung: Du steuerst dich selbst, hältst nach Rückschlägen Kurs und misst dich an Ergebnissen.

  • Zum Hintergrund: Studium, Ausbildung oder Quereinstieg – wir schauen auf Können und Antrieb, nicht auf den Titel. Erfahrung im Recruiting ist willkommen, aber nichts, was wir dir nicht beibringen könnten.

Unser Angebot

  • Vergütung ohne Obergrenze: Fixgehalt als sichere Basis, dazu eine Provision, die nicht gedeckelt ist.

  • Unbefristet vom ersten Tag an: Wir planen langfristig – in einem Markt, der stabil wächst.

  • Klarer Entwicklungspfad: Recruiter, Junior Consultant, Senior Consultant. Das Tempo bestimmst du.

  • Einarbeitung mit Struktur: Umfassendes Onboarding, Trainings zu Recruiting, Beratung und Vertrieb, dazu feste Feedbackrunden.

  • Ausstattung auf Niveau: Höhenverstellbare Tische, Herman-Miller-Stühle, Apple-Hardware – mitten in der Bielefelder Innenstadt.

  • Fitness auf unsere Kosten: Premium-Mitgliedschaft im Studio deiner Wahl.

  • Gut versorgt: Siebträgerkaffee von Julius Meinl, ausgesuchte Tees, flexibles Mittagsangebot über Meyer Menü.

  • Flache Hierarchie: Leistungsorientiert und kollegial, mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung.

Der Ablauf

  1. Bewerben in zwei Minuten – Lebenslauf genügt, kein Anschreiben nötig.

  2. Telefonat zum Kennenlernen – wir melden uns innerhalb von 48 Stunden.

  3. Persönliches Gespräch in unserem Büro in der Bielefelder Innenstadt.

Wenn du Recruiting nicht abarbeiten, sondern gestalten willst: Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

(100% remote, anywhere in Europe)

Are you excited about building ML systems that make predictions in real-time? Are you driven by building things end-to-end, from research to live systems?

At GRID, we are building real-time prediction systems for competitive esports (CS2, Dota 2, League of Legends). Our models power live betting markets, producing continuously updated win probabilities, handicap lines, over/under totals, and specialty markets during matches.

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to lead the research, design, and continuous improvement of our core predictive models.   • Lead Model R&D: Design, build, and optimise the machine learning models and statistical frameworks that power our real-time odds and betting markets.

  • Build state-of-the-art models: Focus on model performance and probability calibration. Design rigorous backtesting frameworks to prevent data leakage and evaluate performance against historical market baselines.

  • Develop Market Logic: Create the mathematical rules and probabilistic derivations that translate baseline win probabilities into complex derivative markets (handicaps, totals, player props).

  • Deploy real-time production systems: Ensure your models are seamlessly translated into production-grade pipelines and microservices.

Your skills will include

Required

  • Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in data science, quantitative research, or statistical modelling.

  • Advanced Mathematical Foundations: Deep, intuitive understanding of probability, statistics, and machine learning theory.

  • Advanced Python Proficiency: Expert-level skills in the Python data stack. You write clean, production-grade code.

  • Evaluation Expertise: Proven experience designing complex backtesting environments and defining custom evaluation metrics for unique business problems.

     

Nice to Have

  • Esports Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of competitive esports (CS2, Dota 2, LoL), the underlying game mechanics, and the competitive meta.

  • High-Frequency/Real-Time Data: Experience modeling off streaming data or data that updates continuously over time.

title: IT Administrator / (Senior) IT Administrator
description:
Apex.AI is an international software company developing safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility and autonomous systems. Our technology enables companies to build software-defined vehicles and intelligent machines faster, safer, and more efficiently. 

We are looking for a hands-on IT Administrator / (Senior) IT Administrator to take ownership of the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of our IT environment in Germany while supporting our international teams. 

This is a highly practical role for someone who enjoys solving technical problems, administering systems, supporting users, and continuously improving IT infrastructure. You will work across Linux and macOS endpoints, identity and access management, cloud services, networks, security tooling, and on-premises infrastructure. 

You will be a key point of contact for IT topics in our Munich office and work closely with Engineering, DevOps, HR, and other business functions. 

In addition to your core IT responsibilities, you will have the opportunity to develop your knowledge of Information Security and compliance, including ISO 27001 and TISAX. Previous compliance experience is welcome but not required—we are looking for someone who is interested in learning and growing in this area. 

As Apex.AI grows, this role offers the opportunity to take on broader ownership and help shape the future of our IT function. 

 
This role is located in our Munich office. Authorization to work in Germany is required.

What You’ll Do

Hands-on IT Administration 

  • Own and manage the day-to-day operation of our cloud and on-premises IT environment.  

  • Administer and support Linux and macOS endpoints throughout their lifecycle.  

  • Manage MDM, IAM, user accounts, permissions, SSO, and MFA.  

  • Administer cloud-based email, collaboration, and file-storage services.  

  • Manage employee access across internal systems and business applications.  

  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot wired and wireless networks.  

  • Manage VPN solutions, network segmentation, policies, and access rules.  

  • Administer and maintain on-premises and cloud-based servers.  

  • Manage endpoint security solutions, including EDR/antivirus, patching, encryption, and security policies.  

  • Implement and maintain integrations between different IT systems.  

  • Automate repetitive IT administration tasks wherever possible.  

  • Monitor systems and proactively identify and resolve issues before they impact users.  

IT Support & Service Delivery 

  • Be a primary point of contact for IT support for employees in our Munich office and provide remote support to colleagues in other locations.  

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, endpoint, network, account, and access issues.  

  • Manage IT support requests and ensure issues are resolved efficiently.  

  • Set up laptops, accounts, permissions, and required applications for new employees.  

  • Execute IT onboarding and offboarding for employees and contractors.  

  • Manage IT hardware inventory and device lifecycle.  

  • Maintain clear and useful technical documentation.  

  • Help create a reliable and user-friendly IT environment where employees can work effectively with minimal friction.  

IT Security & Compliance 

You will have the opportunity to learn how to manage ISMS based on ISO 27001 and TISAX frameworks. We are looking for someone eager to develop in this area. 

You will: 

  • Support the implementation and maintenance of technical security controls.  

  • Help maintain IT documentation, policies, procedures, asset inventories, and access records.  

  • Support evidence collection and technical preparation for ISO 27001 and TISAX audits.  

  • Work with internal and external stakeholders on Information Security topics.  

  • Support vulnerability management, patching, backups, disaster recovery, and security incident readiness.  

  • Help investigate and resolve IT security incidents.  

  • Gradually develop your knowledge of our ISMS and security/compliance requirements.  

  • Contribute ideas for improving the security and resilience of our IT environment.  

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement 

  • Work closely with Engineering and DevOps on infrastructure, access, networking, and security topics.  

  • Support business applications used by HR, Sales, Finance, Legal, and other teams.  

  • Work with IT vendors and service providers when required.  

  • Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements to our IT environment.  

  • Support the secure adoption of AI tools and emerging technologies.  

  • Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and simplification.  


What you bring

  • Several years of hands-on experience as an IT Administrator, System Administrator, IT Engineer, or similar role.  

  • Strong hands-on experience administering Linux and/or macOS environments, with a willingness to become proficient across both.  

  • Experience with endpoint and device management, including MDM, centralized patching, encryption, and security policies.  

  • Experience with IAM, SSO, and MFA.  

  • Experience administering cloud-based productivity and collaboration platforms such as Google Workspace or Microsoft 365.  

  • Solid networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, Wi-Fi, VPNs, VLANs, and firewalls.  

  • Experience administering servers and working with on-premises infrastructure.  

  • Understanding of endpoint security, backups, monitoring, and logging.  

  • Basic scripting or automation skills using Bash, PowerShell, Python, or similar technologies.  

  • A practical troubleshooting mindset and willingness to investigate problems independently.

Mission

Today there is no dedicated owner for business intelligence and analytics.   • Own the data platform: ingestion from Salesforce and other sources into Databricks, data modeling, quality, and documentation.

  • Build the metric layer: one definition per KPI (GMV, NRM, OTP, working capital metrics, and others), agreed with Finance and Operations, versioned and documented.

  • Deliver the three core report suites: financial reporting (CEO, CFO, board), controlling (FP&A), and operational reporting (supply, logistics, commercial).

  • Stand up Metabase as the single reporting front end and migrate departments off ad-hoc Salesforce reports.

  • Partner with Finance (FP&A), Operations, and Commercial as the go-to person for data questions; translate business questions into models and reports.

  • Prepare investor and board reporting data packs together with the CEO and CFO function.

  • Hire and manage one Data/BI Analyst once the foundation stands; define the longer-term team shape.

Must-have

  • Direct experience with the Salesforce data model as a source system, including its object model quirks and API/ETL constraints.

  • Understands the unit economics of a trading, distribution, or marketplace business: gross margin, net revenue margin, working capital, inventory or flow metrics. Physical goods, not pure SaaS.

  • Business-facing communication: comfortable in the room with a CFO or COO, able to push back on metric definitions and prioritize ruthlessly.

  • Player-coach mindset: wants to build hands-on for the first 6-12 months, then lead a small team.

Nice-to-have

  • Prior experience in a venture-backed scale-up between Series A and C.

title: Product Owner - Agentic
description:
About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Your Mission

As Senior Product Owner for our Agentic Team, your mission is to own the end-to-end roadmap for Hawk's suite of agentic products — spanning investigation, customer due diligence, regulatory reporting, and the core platform capabilities that support them. This is the hub for agentic development at Hawk today, and the role carries genuine responsibility for setting the standard for how (semi-)autonomous AI is built and governed in a regulated, high-stakes environment — where a wrong answer can mean a missed financial crime or a false accusation. Product strategy and vision are shaped in close alignment with leadership and stakeholders across adjacent product teams. The role requires the ability to articulate not only what these products do, but why they are built the way they are — and the commercial rationale for why customers should invest in them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the agentic roadmap end-to-end — from backlog prioritization and change/feature request triage through in-year roadmap execution — and be the final point of accountability for what actually ships.

  • Shape product vision and multi-year strategy for the agentic line in close alignment with leadership and key stakeholders across the business. As the senior member of this team, this role carries more forward-looking, strategic weight than a typical PO — helping set direction, not just executing against it.

  • Treat commercial ownership as core to the job, not adjacent to it: pricing, packaging, and CARR/revenue framing sit as close to this role as backlog grooming does.

  • Be the face of the agentic product externally where it matters — representing the roadmap in customer advisory boards, competitive reviews, analyst conversations, and key/enterprise deal support.

  • Act as the connective hub between the agentic team and adjacent screening, fraud, and KYC product teams, ensuring agentic capabilities integrate cleanly instead of bolting on.

  • Keep the product legible to everyone who needs it: own documentation, product briefings, and the product newsletter, the artifacts that let engineering, sales, and customers understand what's being built and why.

  • Run tight, agile delivery day-to-day with development and data science, keeping planning honest and timely without turning process into ceremony.

Your Profile

  • 3–5 years as a Product Owner or Product Manager, and 3–5 years in the financial industry — ideally with direct exposure to Anti-Financial Crime (AML, fraud, sanctions screening, KYC/CDD). We're open on the exact mix; what matters is that both sides are real, not adjacent.

  • Demonstrable, hands-on experience building agentic products in a regulated environment, including familiarity with explainability, safety, accuracy monitoring, and bias considerations.

  • Strong product operations instincts in a fast-moving environment: you run tight, agile processes without turning them into ceremony, adapt quickly when the ground shifts, and keep planning solid instead of firefighting.

  • A sharp, decisive prioritizer with a genuine quality bar: you slice, scope, and rescope work under pressure, defend that scope when it's challenged, and know the difference between shipping fast and shipping sloppy — you don't trade one for the other without a reason.

  • Commercial literacy as a working skill, not an afterthought. You think about pricing and packaging with the same seriousness you bring to feature scoping, because building the right thing and selling the right thing are two different jobs — and both are yours.

Bei GALVANY ist es unser Ziel, klimaneutrales Wohnen für alle zur Realität zu machen. Wir setzen auf Umsetzung und entwickeln konkrete, smarte Lösungen, indem wir Wärmepumpen, Batteriespeicher und Smart Metering einfach zugänglich, zuverlässig und bezahlbar machen.

Wir sind ein profitables Greentech-Startup und glauben, dass nachhaltiger Impact und langfristiges Wachstum nur auf Basis eines gesunden Geschäftsmodells möglich sind. Um unsere ambitionierte Tech Roadmap umzusetzen haben wir im Frühjahr 2026 eine Seed-Finanzierung in Höhe von 10 Millionen Euro mit Set Ventures und AENU abgeschlossen. Getrieben von Kundennutzen, Klarheit und Verantwortung stehen wir für hochwertige Heizlösungen und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und nachhaltigen Mehrwert schaffen.

Als Projektmanager Großprojekte (m/w/d) – Wärmepumpen & Gebäudetechnik bei GALVANY bist du die zentrale operative Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Installationsteams, Lieferanten und internen Abteilungen. Du steuerst komplexe Wärmepumpen-Projekte von der Planung bis zur Abnahme – termingerecht, wirtschaftlich und in hoher Qualität.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Eigenverantwortliche Steuerung von Wärmepumpen-Großprojekten von der Vorbereitung bis zur Abnahme.

  • Täglicher Ansprechpartner für Kunden während der gesamten Projektumsetzung.

  • Planung und Überwachung von Terminen, Ressourcen und Meilensteinen.

  • Koordination von Installationspartnern, Gewerken und allen operativen Abläufen rund um die Installation.

  • Vorbereitung und Begleitung technischer Abnahmen sowie Sicherstellung der vollständigen Projektdokumentation.

  • Frühzeitige Risikoerkennung, Einleitung von Gegenmaßnahmen und regelmäßiges Reporting an die technische Leitung.

Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Versorgungstechnik, Bauingenieurwesen oder Energietechnik oder vergleichbare Berufserfahrung im technischen Projektmanagement.

  • Erfahrung in der Koordination von Bau-, SHK- oder Energieprojekten.

  • Technisches Verständnis für Wärmepumpen, Gebäudetechnik oder verwandte Gewerke.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Projektmanagement- und CRM-Systemen.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1).

Zusätzlich sind uns folgende Fähigkeiten und Eigenschaften wichtig:

  • Structured Thinker: Du arbeitest methodisch, behältst auch bei komplexen Projekten den Überblick und setzt klare Prioritäten.

  • Proactive Problem-Solver: Du erkennst Risiken frühzeitig, handelst eigenverantwortlich und sorgst dafür, dass Probleme gar nicht erst eskalieren.

  • Clear Communicator: Du kommunizierst klar und präzise – mit Kunden, Partnern und internen Stakeholdern auf allen Ebenen.

  • Customer Focused: Du verstehst die Bedürfnisse deiner Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass sie während der gesamten Projektlaufzeit gut begleitet werden.

  • Ownership: Du übernimmst volle Verantwortung für deine Projekte – von der Planung bis zur Abnahme – und treibst sie aktiv voran.

  • Team Player: Du arbeitest eng mit internen Teams und externen Partnern zusammen und trägst zu einer konstruktiven, lösungsorientierten Zusammenarbeit bei.

Benefits

  • Werde Teil eines schnell wachsenden und profitablen Climate-Tech-Startups

  • Attraktive und wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung

  • Unser lebendiges Office ist das Herz unserer Kultur und fördert Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit anteiligem Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung

  • Individuelle Benefits, abgestimmt auf deine Bedürfnisse, z. B. Sportmitgliedschaften, ÖPNV-Ticket oder Learning Budget

title: Senior Product Manager - Finance Automation (f/m/d)
description:

The role:

As our Senior Product Manager – Finance Automation Platform (f/m/d), you will own a brand-new Core Platform domain focused on Finance. Acting as the primary product partner for our Finance Automation team, you will translate financial and accounting requirements into scalable platform capabilities that automate reconciliation, improve data integrity, and enable reliable financial operations.

This is a true domain ownership role. You will define the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for the Finance Platform domain while working closely with Engineering and Finance to build reliable, scalable solutions. You will also help shape the future scope of the platform, including how far ownership should extend into finance systems and accounting processes.

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for the Finance Platform domain, aligning platform investments with Finance and business priorities.

  • Act as the primary product partner between Finance and Core Platform Engineering, building trusted relationships and translating financial requirements into scalable platform capabilities.

  • Drive the automation of reconciliation, accounting workflows, and financial data processing, reducing manual effort and increasing operational reliability.

  • Translate accounting policies, financial controls, and compliance requirements into platform services, data models, and automation.

  • Ensure the reliability, integrity, and auditability of finance-critical data across platform services and infrastructure changes.

  • Partner with Finance to continuously improve reconciliation accuracy, financial reporting, and audit readiness.

  • Collaborate closely with Payments and other product teams to ensure finance-relevant data is generated consistently and reliably across the platform.

  • Establish scalable ways of working, including transparent prioritisation, request management, and stakeholder communication.

  • Define, monitor, and continuously improve KPIs such as reconciliation accuracy, automation coverage, finance data reliability, manual effort reduction, and audit outcomes.

  • Help shape the long-term ownership model for finance-related platform capabilities together with Finance leadership.

What you offer us:

  • Proven experience owning a product or platform domain end-to-end, including product strategy, roadmap definition, prioritisation, and stakeholder management.

  • Strong understanding of finance operations, accounting processes, reconciliation, financial controls, or financial reporting.

  • Ability to translate complex business and financial requirements into scalable technical solutions and platform capabilities.

  • Experience working closely with engineering teams on data-intensive or platform products.

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to build trusted relationships across Finance, Engineering, and other business functions.

  • Strong analytical mindset with experience using KPIs and data to guide product decisions and measure impact.

  • Comfortable operating in an evolving environment where you help shape product scope, ownership, and long-term strategy.

  • Experience with ERP or accounting systems (e.g. Microsoft Business Central), audit processes, or regulated industries is a strong plus.

What we offer you:

  • A modern, dynamic culture grounded in the success of a leading-edge e-commerce company.

title: Product Engineer
description:
Referral bonus: If you know someone exceptional feel free to connect us via LinkedIn (Dennis Agidigbi), if we end up hiring them for a full-time role, you'll receive 10,000€.

🌍 About Zauber

After co-founding and scaling Forto to over $600M in funding, I took a step back to reflect on what’s still broken in global logistics. The answer was clear: it’s still a human-first, spreadsheet-heavy industry, full of repetitive processes and broken system interoperability.

With the rise of AI agents, we now have the tools to rethink that from the ground up. Zauber builds autonomous agents for the global logistics industry, AI workers that handle operational tasks, talk to systems and humans alike, and get better every day.

🚢 We're already live with global logistics leaders in Europe and Asia

💰 Backed by P9 - one of Europe's top early-stage funds

📈 Growing fast and hiring exceptional engineers to join early

Now we are looking for an exceptional Product Engineer to help us define and build the next generation of AI-powered logistics systems.

🧠 What You'll Do

You will help turn vision into product and bring our first AI agents into the hands of real users. This is a high-ownership role, working closely with the founding team and customers to build something truly new. You'll operate across the full stack—talking to customers one hour and debugging an agent loop the next—making the foundational technical decisions that define what the product becomes.

• Talk directly to customers and translate their needs into product direction and system architecture

• Build full-stack features that combine intuitive interfaces with intelligent backend logic, including LLM orchestration, agent workflows, and structured data pipelines

• Push the limits of what LLMs and agents can do in production, working through the hard problems of reliability, latency, and evaluation

• Scale from demo-quality code to robust, production-ready systems, making deliberate tradeoffs between speed and durability as the product matures

• Help shape the technical vision and product strategy of the company

👤 You Might Be a Fit If You...

• Have experience taking full ownership of technical projects, from architecture through to delivery and iteration

• Are pragmatic and fast in the early days, but know when to raise the bar for scale and quality

• Love writing and shipping code, and are not afraid to throw it away when the problem shifts

• Enjoy speaking with users and iterating quickly based on feedback, treating customer insight as a core input to engineering decisions

• Want to build something ambitious and impactful, from the very beginning

🛠 What You Bring

• Strong skills in Node.js, TypeScript, and React, with an instinct for patterns that move fast without creating debt—clean service boundaries, event-driven architectures, thin abstractions that are easy to replace

• Experience with distributed systems and serverless infrastructure that handle concurrency, failure, and scale

• Hands-on MongoDB experience, including schema design that balances query performance with flexibility

• Familiarity with observability tooling, ideally Datadog—tracing across async workflows, using metrics to debug production issues, not just monitor them

• Experience with modern AI tooling: LLMs, vector stores, embedding pipelines, prompt engineering

• Practical understanding of LLM-powered features in production—eval frameworks, structured output parsing, context window management, error recovery

• A track record of shipping products that create real value

• Curiosity for how industries work and a drive to improve them through software

• High-agency mindset and the ability to operate independently in a fast-changing environment

📍 Location & Logistics

• In-person Monday to Wednesday in our Berlin office (travel within Europe expected)

• Annual offsite (last year we took the team for 4 weeks to San Francisco)

• Start: As soon as possible

💼 What We Offer

• Top-of-market compensation and meaningful early equity

• Direct access to real users and fast feedback loops

• A highly experienced team with full trust and autonomy

• The opportunity to shape the foundations of a company and product from day one

• A mission that matters: building intelligent systems to power the future of global trade

🚀 Why Now

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
About the Company:

Tools for Humanity (TFH) designs and builds technology behind World. World is building a real human network designed to accelerate people in the age of AI. As bots and autonomous agents reshape the internet, people, institutions, and applications need a trusted way to confirm who is a real human while preserving privacy. The TFH and World tech stacks make this possible: the Orb verifies real, unique people, World ID proves it privately, and World App puts these capabilities, and more, in people’s hands. Together, they add a human layer to an AI-driven internet.

World is already running at a global scale. More than 17 million people across 160 countries have verified with World ID, and more new Orb verifications take place each week. World App is already among the most used wallets globally. Developers are integrating World ID to build safer online experiences and create spaces where real people can participate, earn, and be recognized in ways AI simply can’t replicate.

Founded in 2019, TFH has more than 400 people across hardware, software, AI, cryptography, mobile engineering, and global operations. Our teams come from OpenAI, Tesla, SpaceX, Apple, Google, Stripe, Meta, Coinbase, Palantir and MIT Media Lab. We’re backed by leading investors, including a16z, Khosla Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Blockchain Capital, Variant, Tiger Global, and Coinbase Ventures, as well as prominent operators and founders across fintech and AI.

TFH and World have been featured on the cover of TIME Magazine, highlighted in Fast Company’s Next 5 in Fintech, and explored in a Bloomberg deep dive. The New York Times, Bankless and TechCrunch have all recognized our collective progress in identity, cryptography, AI, and global-scale hardware deployment. Our leadership is also named to the Time AI 100. Learn more about the newest product launches from our Liftoff event.

About the team

The AI & Biometrics team at Tools for Humanity owns the machine learning systems behind the World Network. Our iris and face recognition systems, our anti-spoofing pipeline, and the models running on the Orb and on phones are what make Proof of Personhood actually work at scale.

Within the Face team, we develop systems for face verification, uniqueness and duplicate detection, presentation attack detection, and supporting capabilities such as face detection, image quality assessment, occlusion detection, pose estimation, and others that allow these systems to operate reliably in real-world conditions.

Our work spans the full machine learning lifecycle: defining data-collection and labeling requirements, curating datasets, conducting applied computer-vision research, training and evaluating models, adversarial testing, supporting deployment, investigating production behavior, and monitoring performance after release.

The problems we work on are grounded in real-world conditions. Our systems must handle variation in cameras, lighting, pose, image quality, occlusion, user behavior, and attack methods. They must also operate within strict latency and memory budgets and interact with privacy-preserving systems (Anonymized Multi-Party Computation) that compare users against a growing identity set. At our scale, small regressions can have a meaningful impact, so evaluation, operating-point selection, and production monitoring are central to how we work.

We are pragmatic about our methods. We use deep learning where it provides clear value, classical computer vision and image processing where they are more efficient or reliable, and hybrid approaches when they produce the best system.

The team is well supported. We have a dedicated Mobile subteam that owns deployment to mobile devices, ML Infrastructure and MLOps subteams that own the data pipelines, training clusters, GPU fleet, and much of the underlying tooling, and Face and Iris subteams dedicated to each modality. Face engineers own problem formulation, data requirements, data-quality decisions, model behavior, evaluation methodology, and investigation of model failures for their projects to succeed. We also work closely with the Orb software, Mobile, Proof of Personhood, and Product teams to take ideas to production.

In this role, you will:

  • Own face machine learning projects from initial problem definition through data preparation, experimentation, evaluation, production validation, and monitoring, while partnering with different teams.

  • Improve our core biometric identification and anti-spoofing models, training and iterating on deep learning architectures, losses, and data pipelines, with model size, latency, and memory budgets as first-class design constraints from day one.

  • Use classical computer vision and image processing when they are the right solution, whether as a complete method, a preprocessing stage, a lightweight on-device component, or a diagnostic tool. We are not a deep learning only team, and on-device compute rewards the discipline of using the lighter solution when it fits.

  • Lead independent applied ML initiatives end-to-end: form a written hypothesis, design ablations that isolate variables, run experiments, read results honestly, and know when to ship and when to stop chasing the last percentage point

  • Work directly with face images and datasets: improve collection and labels, inspect difficult samples, identify failure modes, and use those findings to drive model and evaluation changes.

  • Build evaluation pipelines that catch model regressions before they reach production, monitoring that can reveal data drift, score-distribution changes, new attack patterns, cohort-specific regressions, or unexpected model behavior, and improve internal tools for data analysis, model training, evaluation, visualization, red teaming, and monitoring.

  • Read and evaluate relevant computer vision and biometrics research, adapting useful ideas to our systems without treating paper reproduction as the objective.

  • Write design documents, experiment reports, post-launch analysis and technical proposals that remain useful after the project is complete, and others can understand and build on your work.

  • Help shape technical standards across the AI & Biometrics team: evaluation methodology, experimentation discipline, model versioning, monitoring, and across any engineering and scientific standards of the team.

You may be a strong fit if you have:

  • Significant hands-on experience training, evaluating, and shipping deep learning systems for computer vision, with practical understanding of latency and memory constraints.

  • Experience taking an ambiguous machine learning problem and turning it into a structured technical plan.

  • Strong practical knowledge of model training, including data pipelines, augmentations, architecture selection, loss functions, optimization, hyperparameter tuning, and failure analysis.

  • Strong foundations in classical computer vision and image processing, with experience including tools such as OpenCV, NumPy, or equivalent libraries. Fluency in Python and a modern deep-learning framework such as PyTorch.

  • Experience designing evaluations that support real production decisions, including metric selection, operating thresholds, calibration, dataset construction, slicing, leakage prevention, and regression analysis.

  • The ability to write maintainable research and production-quality code.

  • A pragmatic, applied-research mindset: rigorous about experiments, but able to determine when a result is ready to ship and when further optimization has diminishing value.

  • Strong written communication. You define the problem, requirements, assumptions, experiments, success criteria, and conclusions clearly.

  • A collaborative operating style: you work independently without becoming isolated, and you actively share context and knowledge with others, engaging constructively with constraints from neighboring teams rather than treating them as obstacles. We are not looking for a lone wolf, however brilliant.

  • An "in-the-driver's-seat" operating style: you take ownership of problems end-to-end, drive your work forward without waiting for direction, and stand behind your decisions once they are in production.

  • Additional Nice-to-haves :

    • Direct experience with biometric verification/identification; margin-based metric learning losses and their failure modes; presentation attack and liveness detection; or adversarial evaluation of ML systems.

    • Experience with edge optimization and on-device deployment of ML models. Quantization, pruning, distillation, kernel-level optimization, deployment to mobile NPUs, embedded GPUs, microcontrollers, or other constrained targets.

    • Hands-on experience with Rust for high-performance code paths, and the disposition to optimize for speed rather than treat it as someone else's problem.

    • A background in sensors, imaging, computational photography, or camera ISPs.

    • Familiarity with privacy-preserving computation or machine learning systems that interact with secure multi-party computation.

Most job ads are written by no one, for everyone. I want to do this differently.

I'm Marius, Chief of Staff at voize. This role reports to me, and whoever takes it will work more closely with me than anyone else in the company. So instead of a template, here's what this job is, how I work, and how you can decide whether you'd want to work with me.

💡 What this job actually is

voize is growing fast, and fast-growing companies produce a specific kind of work: topics that matter but belong to no one. A new market needs operational groundwork. An org-wide process needs to be built. A decision needs a sharp analysis behind it. We're building a CEO Office to own exactly this work. You'd be its first hire.

I’ll be honest about the range. One week you’re working on a question that I and the rest of the management team will decide the company’s direction on. The next you're doing operational groundwork nobody will ever applaud. Both matter equally, it's the nature of building an early-stage company. If you need every task to feel glamorous, stop reading here. If "done" is your favorite word, keep going.

To make it concrete, your first months could look like this: you own the operational groundwork for one of our new markets end-to-end - research, vendor and partner setup, local operations - until things simply run. And you build one company-wide process from scratch, for example how cross-functional projects get scoped, prioritized, and tracked, and roll it out across the org. Different altitude, same job: you drive it to done.

🚀 How I work

I give trust and autonomy by default. The way I see my job as a manager: set goals you can actually reach, give you the resources to get there, unblock you when you're stuck, teach you what I know - and then get out of the way. I care about outcomes, not hours.

The flip side: you'll get a lot of freedom and little oversight. That's a gift if you work autonomously, and a problem if you don't. Autonomy doesn't mean silence, though. I expect you to ask for help early, not after something has quietly derailed.

I'm very opinionated and direct. You'll always know where you stand with me, and I expect the same back - including telling me when you think I'm wrong.

🎯 What I look for

Your background matters less than your pattern. You might come from consulting, VC, a startup, or something you built yourself. What I care about is this: you take ownership before anyone assigns it. You can be dropped into a topic you know nothing about and produce clarity within days. You hold a high bar for your own work without anyone checking. You ask a sharp question early instead of defending a wrong assumption late. And pace gives you energy instead of draining it.

If you read that and felt recognized rather than impressed - good sign.

title: Control System Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Your role

You’ll shape how our robots move, sense, and respond, turning control theory into real-world performance

You’ll push existing products further and bring new prototypes to life with both state-of-the-art and experimental methods. In practice, that means: 

  • Exploring advanced algorithms, controllers, calibration, digital signal processing and finding what actually works on hardware

  • Hunting down and fixing interoperability issues across systems and devices

  • 3+ years as a control system engineer or mathematician

  • Strong grounding in control theory, advanced control algorithms, and DSP
  • Solid proficiency in C++, Python, and Matlab
  • Enough electrical and mechanical fluency to read schematics and reason about sensors and components
  • Working knowledge of electric motors and motor control
  • Familiarity with communication protocols (CAN, Ethernet, EtherCAT, TCP/IP)
  • Comfort with professional tooling (git, GitLab, Confluence, JIRA, etc.)
  • Experience with robotic systems is a strong plus

Warum wir?

Code. Chill. Repeat.

Du arbeitest mit modernen, professionellen Tools, mit klaren Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten – du weißt genau, was dein Job ist und hast die Freiheit, ihn so zu machen, wie es richtig ist.
